a: Yeuchar davar shenneemar bo "baarev" uven haarbayim", ledavar shello neemar bo "baerev", ella "ben haarbayim" bilvad.
I hachi, ketoret venerot name nikdemu lefesach: yeuchar davar shenneemar bo "baarev" uven haarbayim", ledavar shello neemar bo ella "ben haarbayim" bilvad!
Shane hatam demiet rachamana "oto". detanya: "meerev vead boker" — ten lah middatah shettehe doleket meerev ad boker.
Davar acher: en lecha avoda shekkeshera meerev ad boker ella zo bilvad. may tama — amar kera: "yaaroch oto aharon uvanav meerev ad boker". oto meerev ad boker, veen davar acher meerev ad boker.
Veittakkash ketoret lenerot.

Vetanya ki kusheyayn: tamid kodem liktoret, ketoret kodemet lenerot, venerot kodmot lefesach. yeuchar davar shenneemar bo "baarev" uven haarbayim", ledavar shello neemar bo ella "ben haarbayim" bilvad.

Veha ketiv "oto"! hay "oto" mibbee leh lemaote avoda shebbifnim, umay nihu? ketoret. salka datach amena hoil uchetiv "uvehaalot aharon et hannerot ben haarbayim yaktirenna", ema: nadlek nerot beresha vahadar nakter ketoret, miet rachamana "oto".
Ella, "ben haarbayim yaktirenna" lema li? hachi kaamar rachamana: beiddan demadlekat nerot tehe mikkatra ketoret.

Tanu rabbanan: en lecha davar shekkodem letamid shel shachar ella ketoret bilvad, shenneemar bah: "babboker babboker". veyukedam ketoret — davar shenneemar bo "babboker babboker", dichtiv: "vehiktir alav aharon ketoret sammim babboker babboker", ledavar shello neemar bo ella "boker" echad.
Veen lecha davar shemmitakkev achar tamid shel ben haarbayim ella ketoret, venerot, ufesach, umechussar kippurim beerev happesach — shettovel shenit veochel et pischo laerev.
Rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: af mechussar kippurim bishar yemot hashshana, shettovel veochel bakkodashim laerev.
Bishlama letanna kamma, yavo ase defesach sheyyesh bo karet, veyidche ase dehashlama sheen bo karet. ella lerabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka, may ulemeh dehay ase mehay ase?!
Amar ravina amar rav chisda: hacha bechattat haof askinan, sheen lemizbeach ella damah.
Rav pappa amar: afillu tema bechattat behema, maaleha umelinah berosho shel mizbeach.
Vehaikka asham. bishlama lerav pappa hayeynu demelin la, ella lerav chisda may ikka lememar? amri: shekkarav ashamo.
Vehaikka ola! vechi tema: ola la meakkeva, vehatanya, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: keshem shechattato vaashamo meakkevin oto, kach olato meakkavto!

Vechi tema beshekkarva olato, umi karva olato kodem lechattato rishon?! vehatanya: "vehikriv et asher lachattat rishona", ma talmud lomar? im lelammed shettehe kodemet laola — hare kevar neemar: "veet hashsheni yaase ola kammishpat".
Ella: ze bana av lechol chattaot sheyyehu kodmot lechol olot habbaot immahen. vekayyma lan daafillu chattat haof kodemet leolat behema!
Amar rava: shane olat metzora, derachamana amar:
b: "Veheela hakkohen et haola" — sheheelah kevar.

Amar leh rav shemen bar abba lerav pappa: ledidach, deamrat maaleha umelinah berosho shel mizbeach, kayyaymin veavdinan milleta lechohanim deatu ba lide takkala, desavri deyomeh hu veatu leaktore! amar leh: kohanim zerizin hen.

Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana, veamri la rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa: veha kamma dela mitkatteri emurin kohanim la matzu achli basar, detanya: yachol yehu kohanim rashshain bechaze vashok kodem haketarat emurin, talmud lomar: "vehiktir hakkohen et hachelev hammizbecha", vahadar: "vehaya hechaze leaharon ulevanav".
Vechamma dechohanim la achli basar bealim la mitkapperi, detanya: "veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem", melammed shehakkohanim ochlim uvealim mitkapperin!

Amar leh: kevan dela efshar — ashaum kemi shennitmeu o sheavdu. detanya: yachol nitmeu emurin o sheavdu lo yehu kohanim zakkain bechaze vashok — talmud lomar: "vehaya hechaze leaharon ulevanav", mikkol makom.
Rav kahana rame: ketiv "lo yalin chelev chaggi ad boker" — ad boker hu dela yalin, ha kol hallayla kullah yalin. uchetiv: "vehiktir aleha chelve hashshelamim" — aleha hashelem kol hakkarbanot kullan!
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la, keshennittotru.

Rame leh rav safra lerav: ketiv "lo yalin labboker zevach chag happasach" — labboker hu delo yalin, ha kol hallayla yalin. vehachtiv: "olat shabbat beshabbatto" — velo olat chol beshabbat, velo olat chol beyom tov!
Amar leh: kevar ramyay nihaleh rav abba bar chiyyay lerabbi avahu, veshanni leh: hacha bearbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat askinan, dechelve shabbat kerevin beyom tov.
Amar leh: mishshum dechelve shabbat kerevin beyom tov, anan neku venema leh dehay kera bearbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat hu dichtiv? amar leh: shivkeh likra, dehu dachek umokem annafsheh.
Mishna happasach sheshshechato shello lishmo, vekibbel vehillech vezarak shello lishmo, o lishmo veshello lishmo, o shello lishmo velishmo — pasul.
Ketzad lishmo veshello lishmo? leshem pesach uleshem shelamim. shello lishmo velishmo — leshem shelamim uleshem pesach.
Gemara bae rav pappa: baavoda achat tenan, o bishte avodot tenan?
Baavoda achat tenan verabbi yose hi, deamar: af bigmar devarav adam nitpas.
Dei rabbi meir — ha amar: tefos lashon rishon,

a: O dilma bishte avodot tenan, vaafillu lerabbi meir deamar tefos lashon rishon — hane mille baavoda achat, aval bishte avodot — mode demippesil.

Amri: aheyay? i nema ashshello lishmo velishmo, ben baavoda achat ben bishte avodot, ben lerabbi meir ben lerabbi yose — ippesil leh mikkammayyta, deha lerabbi yose name, af bigmar devarav adam nitpas it leh. ella: allishmo veshello lishmo — may?
Ta shema: happesach sheshshechato shello lishmo, vekibbel vehillech vezarak shello lishmo. hechi dame? i nema kidkatane, lema li ad dimchashshev lechullehu? mikkammayyta ippesil leh!

Ella lav, hachi katane: happesach sheshshechato shello lishmo, i name shechato lishmo vekibbel vehillech vezarak shello lishmo. i name shechato vekibbel vehillech lishmo, vezarak shello lishmo. dehavya la shete avodot.
Ema sefa: lishmo veshello lishmo, hechi dame? i nema bishte avodot — hayeynu resha! ella lav, baavoda achat verabbi yose hi, deamar: af bigmar devarav adam nitpas.
La, leolam bishte avodot, veresha — dekae bishchita veka mechashshev bishchita, i name, kae bizrika veka mechashshev bizrika.
Sefa — dekae bishchita vekachashev bizrika, deamar: hareni shochet et happesach lishmo lizrok damo shello lishmo. veka mashma lan dimchashshevin meavoda laavoda, vehayeynu baya derav pappa.
Ta shema: o shello lishmo velishmo pasul. hechi dame? i nema bishte avodot, hasheta lishmo veshello lishmo amrat pasul, shello lishmo velishmo mibbaya?!
Ella lav, baavoda achat. umiddesefa baavoda achat — resha name baavoda achat!
La, leolam bishte avodot, uvedin hu dela itzterich leh, veayyeyde ditna lishmo veshello lishmo, tena name shello lishmo velishmo.
Ta shema: shechato shello leochlav, veshello limnuyav, laarelim velitmein — pasul. hacha peshita baavoda achat, umiddesefa baavoda achat — resha name baavoda achat!
Midde irya?! ha kidita veha kidita: sefa — baavoda achat, resha — i baavoda achat, i bishte avodot.
Ta shema: leochlav veshello leochlav — kasher. hechi dame? i nema bishte avodot, vetama dechashshev bizrika, deen machshevet ochlin bizrika —
Ha baavoda achat, kegon bishchita demahneya bay machshevet ochlin — pasul, veha kayyma lan miktzat ochlin la pasla!
b: Ella lav: baavoda achat, umiddesefa baavoda achat — resha name baavoda achat!
Midde irya?! ha kidita veha kidita. sefa baavoda achat, veresha o baavoda achat, o bishte avodot.
Ibbaya lehu: pesach sheshshechato bishar yemot hashshana lishmo veshello lishmo, mahu? mi ate shello lishmo umappek leh mide lishmo umachshir leh, o la?

Ki ata rav dimi amar, amrita lishmata kammeh derabbi yirmeya: hoil velishmo machshiro bizmanno, veshello lishmo machshiro shello bizmanno: ma lishmo hammachshiro bizmanno — en motzio mide shello lishmo, af shello lishmo hammachshiro shello bizmanno — en motzio mide lishmo, ufasul.
Vaamar li: lo! im amarta beshello lishmo shekken noheg bechol hazzevachim, tomar belishmo shekken eno noheg bechol hazzevachim ella bappesach bilvad.
May have ala? amar rava: pesach sheshshechato bishar yemot hashshana lishmo veshello lishmo — kasher. deha setamo lishmo kae, vaafillu hachi, ki shachet leh shello lishmo — kasher,
Alma: ate shello lishmo umappek leh mide lishmo. ki shachet name lishmo veshello lishmo — ate shello lishmo umappek leh mide lishmo.

Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava: dilma shane hecha deamar mehecha dela amar. deha leochlav veshello leochlav kasher, vechol hecha deshachet leh shello leochlav lechodeh — pasul, veammay? ha setama leochlav kae. ella shane hecha deamar mehecha dela amar. hachi name, shane hecha deamar mehecha dela amar!
Amar leh: mide irya? bishlama hatam kamma dela akar leh bishchita — setameh vadday lishmo kae. ella hacha — setameh leochlav kae?!
Dilma mimmashchi hane veate acharine umimmeni illaveh, (acharine) ditnan: nimnin umoshchin et yedehem mimmennu, ad sheyyishchat.
Ibbaya lehu: pesach sheshshechato bishar yemot hashshana beshinnuy bealim, mahu? shinnuy bealim keshinnuy kodesh dame — umachshayr leh, o la?

Amar rav pappa, amrita lishmata kammeh derava: hoil veshinnuy kodesh poslo bizmanno, veshinnuy bealim poslo bizmanno. ma shinnuy kodesh shepposlo bizmanno — machshiro leachar zemanno, af shinnuy bealim shepposlo bizmanno — machshiro leachar zemanno.
Veamar li: lo! im amarta beshinnuy kodesh — shekken pesulo begufo, veyeshno bearba avodot,

a: Veyeshno leachar mita, veyeshno betzibbur kevayyachid. tomar beshinnuy bealim — deen pesulo begufo, veeno bearba avodot, veeno leachar mita, veeno betzibbur kevayyachid.
Veaf al gav detarte lav davka, tarte miha davka. demay shena shinnuy bealim dela have pesulo begufo — difsulo machshava bealma hi. shinnuy kodesh name — pesulo machshava bealma hi.
Vetu, ha deamar shinnuy bealim eno leachar mita, ulerav pinchas bereh derav amme deamar yesh shinnuy bealim leachar mita, may ikka lememar? tarte mihat davka ninhu.
Ella, amar rava: pesach sheshshechato bishar yemot hashshana beshinnuy bealim — naasa kemi sheen lo bealim bizmanno, ufesul.
Mishna shechato shello leochlav, veshello limnuyav, laarelim velitmeim — pasul. leochlav veshello leochlav limnuyav veshello limnuyav, lemulim velaarelim, litmeim velithorim — kasher.
Shechato kodem chatzot — pasul, mishshum shenneemar "ben haarbayim". shechato kodem lattamid — kasher, uvilvad sheyyehe acher memares bedamo ad sheyyizzarek hattamid. veim nizrak — kasher.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: ketzad shello leochlav? leshum chole o leshum zaken. ketzad shello limnuyav? nimnu alav chavura zo, ushechato leshem chavura acheret.
Menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "bemichsat" — melammed sheen happesach nishchat ella limnuyav,
Yachol shechato shello limnuyav yehe keover al hammitzva vechasher — talmud lomar: "bemichsat ... tachossu", hakkatuv shana alav leakkev.
Rabbi omer: lashon suresi hu, keadam sheomer lachavero "kos li tale ze".
Ashkechan shello limnuyav, shello leochlav mena lan? amar kera "ish lefi ochlo tachossu", ittakkash ochlin limnuyin.
b: Shechato lemulin, al menat sheyyitkapperu bo arelim bizrika. rav chisda amar: pasul. rabba amar: kasher. rav chisda amar pasul — yesh machshevet arelim bizrika. rabba amar kasher — en machshevet arelim bizrika.

Amar rabba: mena amena la? detanya: yachol yifsol bene chavura habbain immo? vedin hu: hoil veorla poselet vetumea poselet, ma tumea lo asa bah miktzat tumea kechol tumea — af orla lo asa bah miktzat orla kechol orla.
O kallech lederech zo: hoil veorla poselet uzeman posel, ma zeman — asa bah miktzat zeman kechol zeman, af orla — asa bah miktzat orla kechol orla.
Nire lemi dome: danin davar sheeno noheg bechol hazzevachim middavar sheeno noheg bechol hazzevachim, veal yochiach zeman shennoheg bechol hazzevachim.
O kallech lederech zo: danin davar shello huttar mikkelalo middavar shello huttar mikkelalo, veal tochiach tumea — shehuttera mikkelalah.
Talmud lomar "zot". may "zot"? illema dechulla orla — pasla, miktzata — la pasla, hay mivvechol arel" nafka!

Ella lav hachi katane: talmud lomar "vechol arel" — kulla orla pasla, miktzata — la pasla. vechi tema hu haddin lizrika, dechulla orla miha pasla — talmud lomar "zot": bishchita hu dechulla orla miha pasla, aval zerika — afillu kulla orla name la pasla.
Vechi tema may kulla dizrika? deen machshevet ochlin bizrika.

Verav chisda, adderabba leiddach gisa: talmud lomar "vechol arel" — kulla orla pasla, miktzatah — la pasla. aval zerika — afillu miktzatah name pasla. vechi tema hu haddin lizrika, dead deikka kulla orla la pasla, talmud lomar "zot": shechita hu demiktzata la pasla, aval zerika — afillu miktzata pasla.
Vechi tema umay chumereh dizrika? dela mikkeva piggul ella bizrika.

Matkef la rav ashe: mimmay dehay "vechol arel" kulla mashma? dilma hay "vechol arel" mashma kol dehu orla, ketav rachamana "zot", dead deikka kulla orla — la pasla, la shena bishchita vela shena bizrika. ella amar rav ashe: rav chisda verabba

a: Behay kera kamippalgi: "venirtza lo lechapper alav" — alav velo al chavero. rabba savar: chavero dumeya dideh. ma hu devar kappara — af chavero devar kappara, leappoke hay arel delav bar kappara hu.
Verav chisda savar: hay arel name, kevan devar chiyyuva hu — bar kappara hu, [hoil] dei bae metakken nafsheh.
Umi it leh lerav chisda "hoil"? veha ittemar: haofe miyyom tov lechol, rav chisda amar: loke. rabba amar: eno loke.
Rabba amar eno loke: amrinan "hoil vei mikkali leh orchim chaze leh, hasheta name chaze leh" vela lake. rav chisda amar loke: la amrinan "hoil".
Bishlama derabba adderabba la kashya: hacha mechussar maase, hatam dela mechussar maase. ella derav chisda adderav chisda kashya! amri: ki let leh lerav chisda "hoil" — lekulla, lechumera — it leh.

Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: katane, hoil vearla poselet vetumea poselet, ma tumea lo asa bah miktzat tumea kechol tumea — af orla lo asa miktzat orla kechol orla. hay tumea hechi dame? illema betumeat gavre, umay "lo asa bah miktzat tumea kechol tumea" — dei ikka arbea vechamsha gavre temein vearbea vechamsha gavre tehorin, la pasli lehu temein lithorin,
Gabbe orla name ha la pasli, ditnan: lemulin velaarelim — kasher. may shena tumea difshita leh, umay shena orla dimsappeka leh?
Ella betumeat basar, umay lo asa bah miktzat tumea kechol tumea? deillu ittammi chad meevarim — hay deittammi sarfinan leh, veiddach — achlinan leh.

Bemay okemta — betumeat basar? ema sefa: danin davar sheeno noheg bechol hazzevachim middavar sheeno noheg bechol hazzevachim, veal yochiach zeman shennoheg bechol hazzevachim. umay tumea? i nema tumeat basar, ammay eno noheg bechol hazzevachim?

Ella peshita betumeat gavre, umay eno noheg bechol hazzevachim? deillu bechol hazzevachim — arel vetame meshallechin korbenotehen, veillu befesach — arel vetame en meshallechin pischehen. resha betumeat basar vesefa betumeat gavre!
Amar leh: in, shem tumea ka farech.
Veibbaet ema: sefa name betumeat basar. umay "eno noheg bechol hazzevachim"? deillu bechol hazzevachim ben shennitma chelev uvasar kayyaym, ben shennitma basar vechelev kayyaym — zorek et haddam.
Veillu befesach, nitma chelev uvasar kayyaym — zorek et haddam, nitma basar vechelev kayyaym — eno zorek et haddam.
Bemay okemta — betumeat basar? ema sefa: danin davar shello huttar mikkelalo middavar shello huttar mikkelalo, veal tochiach tumea shehare huttera mikkelalah. bemay? ilema
b: Betumeat basar — hecha huttera? ella peshita betumeat gavre, vehecha huttera mikkelalah — betzibbur.
Resha betumeat basar, sefa betumeat gavre! in — shem tumea kafarech.
Veibbaet ema: kulla betumeat basar, vehecha huttera — betumeat pesach, ditnan: pesach habba betumea — neechol betumea, shello ba mittechillato ella laachila.
Metiv rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: happesach sheavra shenato, ushechato bizmanno lishmo, vechen hashshochet acherim leshem pesach bizmanno — rabbi eliezer posel, verabbi yehoshua machshir.
Tama bizmanno, ha shello bizmanno — kasher. veammay? nema: hoil uvizmanno posel, shello bizmanno name posel!
Amar rav pappa: shane hatam deamar kera "vaamartem zevach pesach hu" — hu bahavayayto: lo hu leshum acherim, velo acherim lishmo.
Bizmanno, shehu pasul leshum acherim — acherim pesulin lishmo. shello bizmanno, shehu kasher leshum acherim — acherim kesherim lishmo.

Rabbi simlay ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar leh: nitne li mar sefer yuchasin. amar leh: mehechan at? amar leh: millod. vehechan motvach? binhardea. amar leh: en niddonin lo leluddim velo linhardeim, vechol shekken deat millod umotvach binhardea. kafyeh veiratztzi.

Amar leh: nitneyeh bitlata yarche. shekal kala petak beh, amar leh: uma berureya devethu derabbi meir beratte derabbi chananya ben teradyon, detanya telat mea shematata beyoma mittelat mea rabbevota, vaafillu hachi lo yatzta yede chovatah bitlat shenin, veat amrat bitlata yarche?!
Ki shakel veazel amar leh: rabbi, ma ben lishmo veshello lishmo, leochlav veshello leochlav?
Amar leh: hoil vetzureba merabbanan at, ta veema lecha: lishmo veshello lishmo — pesulo begufo, leochlav veshello leochlav — en pesulo begufo.
Lishmo veshello lishmo — i efshar levarer issuro, leochlav veshello leochlav — efshar levarer issuro.

Lishmo veshello lishmo — yeshno bearba avodot, leochlav veshello leochlav — eno bearba avodot. lishmo veshello lishmo — yeshno betzibbur kivyachid, leochlav veshello leochlav — eno betzibbur kivyachid.
Rav ashe amar: pesulo begufo vei efshar levarer issuro — chada milleta hi, dema taam amar pesulo begufo? mishshum dei efshar levarer issuro.
Amar rame bar rav yuda amar rav: miyyom shennignaz sefer yuchasin tashash kochan shel chachamim vechaha meor enehem.
Amar mar zutera: ben "atzel" leatzal" teinu arba mea gamle didrasha.
Tanya, acherim omrim: hikdim mulim laarelim — kasher, arelim lemulim — pasul. may shena mulin laarelim dechasher — dechulla orla baenan, velekka? arelim lemulin name, kulla orla baenan, velekka!

a: Lema kasavri acherim enah lishchita ella bassof, vechidrava. deamar rava: adayin hi machaloket.
Hilkach: hikdim mulin laarelim — mulin chayyli, arelim la chayyli. hikdim arelim lemulin — arelim chayyli, mulin la chayyli.

Amar rabba: la, leolam kasavri acherim yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof, vehacha bemay askinan — kegon sheggamar belibbo letarvavyyhu, ben lemulin ben laarelim, vehotzi befiv "laarelim", velo hispik lomar "lemulin" ad shennigmera shechita baarelim". uveha peligi, derabbi meir savar: la baenan piv velibbo shavim. verabbanan savri baenan piv velibbo shavim.

Vekasavar rabbi meir la baenan piv velibbo shavin? ureminhu: hammitkavven lomar "teruma", veamar "maaser"; "maaser", veamar "teruma". o: "sheeni nichnas levayit ze", veamar "laze"; "sheeni nehene laze", veamar "laze" — lo amar kelum ad sheyyehu piv velibbo shavin.

Ella amar abbaye: resha, deamar "siman rishon lemulin, vesiman sheni af laarelim" — divsiman sheni name petichi beh mulin. sefa, deamar "siman rishon laarelim, siman sheni lemulim" — divsiman rishon ha la petichi beh mulin.
Verabbi meir letameh, deamar: mefaggelin bachatzi mattir. verabbanan letamayyhu, deamri: en mefaggelin bachatzi mattir.

Mishna hashshochet et happesach al hechametz — over belo taase. rabbi yehuda omer: af hattamid. rabbi shimon omer: happesach bearbaa asar lishmo — chayyayv, veshello lishmo — patur. ushear kol hazzevachim, ben lishman uven shello lishman — patur.
Uvammoed, lishmo — patur. shello lishmo — chayyayv. ushear kol hazzevachim, ben lishman ben shello lishman — chayyayv. chutz min hachattat sheshshechato shello lishmah.
Gemara amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: leolam eno chayyayv ad sheyyehe hechametz lashshochet o lazzorek
b: O leechad mibbene chavura, vead sheyyehe immo baazara. rabbi yochanan amar: af al pi sheen immo baazara. bemay kamippalgi? illema beal" besamuch kamippalgi, derabbi shimon ben lakish savar: "al" besamuch, verabbi yochanan savar: la baenan "al" besamuch. veha ippeligu ba chada zimna!
Ditnan: hashshochet toda lifnim velachmah chutz lachoma — lo kadash hallechem.

May chutz lachoma? rabbi yochanan amar: chutz lechomat bet page, aval chutz lechomat haazara — kadesh, vela baenan "al" besamuch. rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: afillu chutz lechomat azara la kadesh. alma baenan "al" besamuch.
Ella behateraat safek kamippalgi. beha name ha peligi va chada zimna!

Deittemar: "shevua sheochal kikkar zo hayyom", veavar hayyom velo achalah, rabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish deamri tarvayyhu — eno loke. rabbi yochanan amar: eno loke, mishshum dehave leh lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase — en lokin alav. aval hateraat safek — shemah hateraa.
Verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: eno loke, mishshum dehave leh hateraat safek, vehateraat safek — lo shemah hateraa. aval lav sheen bo maase — lokin alav.

Amri: leolam beal" besamuch ka mippalgi, utzericha, dei ippeligu leinyan chametz, hava amena: behahu hu dekaamar rabbi yochanan dela baenan "al" besamuch — mishshum deissur hu, vechol hecha deiteh — iteh.
Aval leinyan mikdash lechem — la kadesh ella bifnim, ema mode leh lerabbi shimon ben lakish devaenan "al" besamuch, dei iteh gavvay — kadesh, i la — la kadesh, midde dehave akkele sharet. tzericha.

Vei ashmeinan leinyan mikdash lechem, hava amena: behach kaamar rabbi shimon ben lakish devaenan "al" besamuch, dei iteh gavvay — kadesh, i la — la kadesh, aval leinyan chametz mode leh lerabbi yochanan dela baenan "al" besamuch, deissura hu, vechol hecha deiteh — iteh, tzericha.
Bea minneh rav oshaya merabbi amme: en lo lashshochet, veyesh lo leechad mibbene chavura mahu? amar leh: mi ketiv "lo tishchat al chametzcha"? "lo tishchat al chametz" ketiv.
Amar leh: i hachi, afillu leechad besof haolam name? amar leh: amar kera "lo tishchat ... velo yalin" — "lo tishchat al chametz" — hanach dekayymi aleh mishshum "lo yalin".
Amar rav pappa: hilkach kohen hammaktir et hachelev — over belo taase, hoil veyeshno bichlal halanat emurin.

Tanya kevoteh derav pappa: hashshochet et happesach al hechametz — over belo taase. ematay? bizman shehu lashshochet o lazzorek o leechad mibbene chavura. haya leechad besof haolam — en zakuk lo. veechad hashshochet veechad hazzorek veechad hammaktir — chayyayv. aval hammolek et haof bearbaa asar — eno over belo kelum.

Ureminhi: hashshochet et happesach al hechametz — over belo taase. rabbi yehuda omer: af hattamid. amru lo: lo amru ella befesach bilvad. ematay? bizman sheyyesh lashshochet o lazzorek o leechad mibbene chavura. haya leechad besof haolam — en zakuk lo.
Veechad hashshochet veechad hazzorek veechad hammolek veechad hammazze — chayyayv. aval hakkometz et hammincha — eno over belo taase. hammaktir et haemurin — eno over belo taase.

a: Kashya melika ammelika, kashya haketara ahaktara!
Uletamaych, tikshe lach hi gufa. dekatane: lo amru ella befesach bilvad, vahadar tane: echad hashshochet veechad hazzorek veechad hammolek veechad hammazze!
Ella: ha veha rabbi shimon. melika ammelika la kashya: kan — bearbaa asar, kan — bechullo shel moed. veidde veidde rabbi shimon hi.
Haketara ahaktara name la kashya — tannae hi. deikka demakkesh haketara lishchita, veikka man dela makkesh.
Rabbi yehuda omer: af hattamid vechulei. may tama derabbi yehuda? amar lach: "zivchi" — zevach hameyuchad li, umay nihu? tamid.
Rabbi shimon omer: happesach bearbaa asar vechulei. may tama derabbi shimon? dichtiv "zivchi" "zivchi" tere zimne, keri beh: "zevach, zevachayy".
Lemay hilcheta palginhu rachamana mehadade vela ketav "zevachayy"? lememar: bizman deikka zevach — la michayyayv azzevachayy. bizman delekka zevach — michayyayv azzevachayy.
Uvammoed lishmo patur vechulei. tama deshello lishmo, ha setama — patur.
Ammay? pesach bishar yemot hashshana shelamim have! shamat minna pesach bishar yemot hashshana bae akira!
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar gamda: nizreka mippi chavura, veamru: kegon shehayu bealim temee met, venidchin lefesach sheni, distameh leshum pesach kae.

Mishna happesach nishchat beshalosh kittot, shenneemar: "veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael", kahal, veeda, veyisrael. nichnesa kat harishona, nitmallea haazara, naalu daltot haazara, taku heriu vetaku,

Hakkohanim omdim shurot shurot, uvidehem bezichi chesef uveziche zahav. shura shekkullah kesef kesef, veshura shekkullah zahav zahav, lo hayu meoravin. velo hayu labbazichin shulayim, shemma yannichum veyikkaresh haddam.
Shachat yisrael, vekibbel hakkohen. notno lachavero, vachavero lachavero. umekabbel et hammale, umachazir et harekan. kohen hakkarov etzel hammizbeach zorko zerika achat keneged hayyesod.

Yatzta kat rishona, venichnesa kat sheniyya. yatzta sheniyya, nichnesa shelishit. kemaase harishona kach maase hashsheniyya vehashshelishit. karu et hahallel. im gamru — shanu, veim shanu — shilleshu, af al pi shello shilleshu mimehem. rabbi yehuda omer: mimehem shel kat shelishit lo higgiu leahavti ki yishma Adonai", mippene sheammah muatin.

Kemaasehu bachol kach maasehu bashshabbat, ella shehakkohanim medichim et haazara shello birtzon chachamim. rabbi yehuda omer: kos haya memalle middam hattaarovet, zerako zerika achat al gabbe hammizbeach. velo hodu lo chachamim.

Ketzad tolin umafshitin? uneklayot shel barzel hayu kevuim bakketalim uvaammudim shebbahen tolin umafshitin. kol mi sheen lo makom litlot ulehafshit — maklot dakkim vachalakim hayu sham, manniach al ketefo veal ketef chavero, vetole umafshit. rabbi eliezer omer: arbaa asar
b: Shechal lihyot bashshabbat, manniach yado al ketef chavero, veyad chavero al ketefo, vetole umafshit. kerao, vehotzi et emurav. netano bemages, vehiktiran al gabbe hammizbeach.
Yatzta kat harishona veyashva lah behar habbayit. sheniyya bachel, vehashshelishit bimkomah omedet. chashecha — yatzu vetzalu et pischehen.
Gemara amar rabbi yitzchak: en happesach nishchat ella beshalosh kittot shel sheloshim sheloshim bene adam. may tama? "kahal" veeda" veyisrael". mesappeka lan i bevat achat i beze achar ze,

Hilkach baenan shalosh kittot shel sheloshim sheloshim bene adam. dei bevat achat — ha ikka, vei baze achar ze — ha ikka, hilkach bechamshin name saggi, deayyli telatin veavdi, ayyli asra venafki asra, ayyli asra venafki asra.
Nichnesa kat rishona vechulei. ittemar, abbaye amar: ninalu tenan. rava amar: noalin tenan.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu lemismach annissa. abbaye amar: ninalu tenan, kamma daayaylu meallu, vesamchinan annissa. rava amar: noalin tenan, vela samchinan annissa.

Veha ditnan, amar rabbi yehuda: chas veshalom sheakavya ben mahalalel nitnadda, sheen azara ninelet al kol adam beyisrael bechochma uveyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel. abbaye metaretz letameh, verava metaretz letameh. abbaye metaretz letameh: en baazara beshaa shenninala al kol adam beyisrael bechochma uveyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel: rava metaretz letameh: en baazara beshaa shennoalin otah al kol yisrael bechochma uveyirat chet kaakavya ben mahalalel.
Tanu rabbanan: meolam la nitmaech adam baazara, chutz mippesach echad shehaya bime hillel, shennitmaech bo zaken echad, vehayu korin oto "pesach meuchin".

Tanu rabbanan: paam achat bikkesh agrippas hammelech litten enav beucheluse yisrael. amar leh lechohen gadol: ten enecha bappesachim. natal kuleya mikkol echad, venimtzeu sham shishshim ribbo zuge chelayot kiflayim keyotze mitzrayim. chutz mittame veshehaya bederech rechoka. veen lach kol pesach ufesach shello nimnu alav yoter measara bene adam. vehayu korin oto "pesach meubbin".
Natal kuleya? ha bae aktura! dahadar makter lehu. vehachtiv: "vehiktiro", shello yearev chalavav shel ze baze!
Dahadar makter lehu chada chada. vehatanya "vehiktiram", sheyyehe kullo keechad! ella: tefisa bealma, deshakel minnayyhu ad deyahavin leh midde acharina.
Kohanim omdin shurot vechulei. may tama? illema dilma shakli dedahava umeayyeyli dechaspa — hachi name, dilma shakli bar matan umeayyeyli bar mea! ella, dehachi shappir tefe.
Velo hayu labbazichin shulayim vechulei. tanu rabbanan: kol habbazichin shebbammikdash lo hayu lahen shulayim, chutz mibbeziche levona shel lechem happanim — shemma yannichum veyifros hallechem.
Shachat yisrael vekibbel hakkohen vechulei. la saggi delav yisrael?! hi gufa ka mashma lan, dishchita bezar keshera. vekibbel hakkohen. ha kamashma lan, mikkabbala veelach mitzvat kehunna.
Notno lachavero. shamat minna holacha shello baregel — havya holacha! dilma hu nayed pureta. veella may ka mashma lan? ha kamashma lan: "berov am haderat melech".
Kibbel et hammale umachzir et harekan vechulei. aval ippecha la — mesayyay leh lerabbi shimon ben lakish, deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: en maavirin al hammitzvot.
Kohen hakkarov etzel hammizbeach vechulei. man tana pesach bizrika? amar rav chisda: rabbi yose haggelili hi.

Detanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: "et damam tizrok al hammizbeach veet chelbam taktir" — "damo" lo neemar, ella "damam". "chelbo" lo neemar, ella "chelbam". limmed al bechor umaaser ufesach, shehen teunin mattan damim veemurin legabbe mizbeach.

Menalan ditunin yesod? amar rabbi elazar: atya "zerika" "zerika" meola. ketiv hacha: "et damam tizrok al hammizbeach", uchetiv hatam: "vezarku bene aharon hakkohanim et damo al hammizbeach saviv", ma ola teuna yesod — af pesach name taun yesod.

a: Veola gufa menalan? amar kera: "el yesod mizbach haola", alma ola teuna yesod.
Yatzta kat rishona vechulei. tana: hi nikret kat atzlanit. veha la saggi delav hachi, may have lehu lemibad?

Afillu hachi, ibbei lehu lezaroze nafshayyhu. kidtanya, rabbi omer: i efshar leolam belo bassam uvelo buresi. ashre mi sheummanuto bassam, oy lo mi sheummanuto buresi. vei efshar leolam belo zecharim uvelo nekevot. ashre mi shebbanav zecharim, oy lo mi shebbanav nekevot.
Kemaasehu bachol vechulei. shello birtzon man? amar rav chisda: shello birtzon rabbi eliezer. dei rabbanan — ha amri shevut hu, veen shevut bemikdash.

May hi? detanya: echad hacholev vehamechabbetz vehamegabben — kigrogrot. hamechabbed vehamerabbetz veharode challot devash beshogeg beshabbat — chayyayv chattat, hezid beyom tov — loke et haarbaim, divre rabbi eliezer.
Vachachamim omrim, echad ze veechad ze eno ella mishshum shevut.
Rav ashe amar: afillu tema shello birtzon chachamim — verabbi natan hi. detanya, rabbi natan omer: shevut tzericha hittiru, shevut sheenah tzericha lo hittiru.
Rabbi yehuda omer kos haya memalle vechulei. tanya rabbi yehuda omer: kos haya memalle middam hattaarovot, sheim yishshafech damo shel echad mehen — nimtza ze machshiro.
Amru lo lerabbi yehuda: vahalo lo nitkabbel bichli? mena yadi?! ella hachi kaamri leh: shemma lo nitkabbel bichli? amar lahen: af ani lo amarti ella benitkabbel bichli.
Mena yada? kohanim zerizin hen. i zerizin — ammay mishtefich? aggav zerizutayyhu deavdi, mishtefich.
Vahalo dam hattamtzit meorav bo! rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: dam hattamtzit — dam mealleya hu. detanya: dam hattamtzit beazhara, rabbi yehuda omer: behikkaret.
Vehaamar rabbi elazar: mode rabbi yehuda leinyan kappara sheeno mechapper, shenneemar: "ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper",
b: Dam shehannefesh yotza bo — mechapper. dam sheen hannefesh yotza bo — eno mechapper. ella rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: en dam mevattel dam.
Tanya, amar lahen rabbi yehuda lachachamim: ledivrechem, lamma pokkin et haazara? amru lo: shevach hu livne aharon sheyyelchu ad arkubbotehem bedam.
Veha ka chayetz?! lach hu veeno chotzetz. kidtanya: haddam vehaddeyo vehechalav vehaddevash, yeveshim — chotztzin, lachin — en chotztzin.

Veha kamittavvevsi manayyhu, (utenan) hayu begadav metushetashin veavad — avodato pesula! vechi tema dimdallu lehu lemanayyhu, vehatanya: "middo bad" — middo kemiddato, shello yechasser velo yotir! beholachat evarin lakkevesh — delav avoda hi.
Vela? veha middevae kehunna — avoda hi! detanya: "vehikriv hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha", zo holachat evarim lakkevesh! ella: beholachat etzim lammaaracha, delav avoda hi.
Beholachat evarim lakkevesh uveholachat dam, miha hechi azli? dimsaggi aitzteve.
Ketzad tolin umafshitin vechulei. kerao, vehotziu et emurav. netanam bemages lehaketiram. attu hu gufeh hava maktar lehu? ema: lehaketiran al gabbe hammizbeach.
Yatzta kat rishona vechulei. tana: kol echad veechad noten pischo beoro, umafshil laachorav. amar rav ilish: tayyayut.
Hadaran alach tamid nishchat

Mishna ellu devarim bappesach dochin et hashshabbat: shechitato, uzerikat damo, umichuy keravav, vehaketarat chalavav. aval tzeliyyayto vahadachat keravav — enan dochin et hashshabbat. harekavato, vahavaato michutz lattechum, vachatichat yabbalto — en dochin et hashshabbat. rabbi eliezer omer: dochin.

Amar rabbi eliezer: vahalo din hu: ma im shechita shehi mishshum melacha — docha et hashshabbat, ellu, shehen mishshum shevut — lo yidchu et hashshabbat? amar leh rabbi yehoshua: yom tov yochiach, shehittiru bo mishshum melacha, veasur bo mishshum shevut.

Amar leh rabbi eliezer: ma ze yehoshua?! ma reaya reshut lemitzva? heshiv rabbi akiva, veamar: hazzaa tochiach, shehi mishshum mitzva, vehi mishshum shevut, veenah docha et hashshabbat. af atta al titma al ellu, sheaf al pi shehen mishshum mitzva, vehen mishshum shevut, lo yidchu et hashshabbat.
Amar lo rabbi eliezer, vealeha ani dan: uma im shechita shehi mishshum melacha — docha et hashshabbat, hazzaa shehi mishshum shevut — eno din sheddocha et hashshabbat?

a: Amar lo rabbi akiva, o chilluf: ma im hazzaa shehi mishshum shevut — enah docha et hashshabbat, shechita shehi mishshum melacha — eno din shello tidche et hashshabbat?! amar lo rabbi eliezer: akiva, akarta ma shekkatuv battora: "bemoado", ben bachol ben bashshabbat.

Amar lo: rabbi, have li moed leellu, kemoed lashshechita. kelal amar rabbi akiva: kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat — enah docha et hashshabbat. shechita, shei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat — docha et hashshabbat.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: halacha zo nitallema mibbene vetira. paam achat chal arbaa asar lihyot beshabbat, shachchu velo yadu im pesach doche et hashshabbat im lav. amru: kelum yesh adam sheyyodea im pesach doche et hashshabbat im lav? amru lahem: adam echad yesh sheala mibbavel vehillel habbavli shemo, sheshshimmesh shene gedole haddor shemaya veavtalyon, veyodea im pesach doche et hashshabbat im lav. shalchu vekaru lo, amru lo: kelum atta yodea im happesach doche et hashshabbat im lav? amar lahem: vechi pesach echad yesh lanu bashshana sheddoche et hashshabbat? vahalo harebe yoter mimmatayim pesachim yesh lanu bashshana sheddochin et hashshabbat.
Amru lo: minnayin lecha? amar lahem: neemar "moado" bappesach, veneemar "moado" battamid: ma "moado" haamur battamid doche et hashshabbat, af "moado" haamur bappesach doche et hashshabbat.
Veod, kal vachomer hu: uma tamid sheen anush karet doche et hashshabbat, pesach sheanush karet — eno din sheddoche et hashshabbat.

Miyyad hoshivuhu barosh, uminnuhu nasi alehem, vehaya doresh kol hayyom kullo behilchot happesach. hitchil mekanteran bidvarim. amar lahen: mi garam lachem sheele mibbavel veehye nasi alechem — atzlut shehayta bachem, shello shimmashtem shene gedole haddor, shemaya veavtalyon.
Amru lo: rabbi, shachach velo hevi sakkin meerev shabbat, mahu? amar lahen: halacha zo shamati veshachachti, ella hannach lahen leyisrael, im en neviim hen — bene neviim hen.
Lemachar, mi sheppischo tale — tochavo betzamro, mi sheppischo gedi — tochavo ben karnav. raa maase venizkar halacha, veamar: kach mekubbelani mippi shemaya veavtalyon.

Amar mar: neemar "moado" bappesach, veneemar "moado" betamid, ma "moado" haamur battamid doche et hashshabbat, af "moado" haamur bappesach doche shabbat. vetamid gufeh menalan dedache shabbat? illema mishshum dichtiv beh "bemoado" — pesach name ha ketiv beh "moado"!
Ella "moado" la mashma leh. hacha name "moado" la mashma leh. ella amar kera: "olat shabbat beshabbatto al olat hattamid" — mikkelal [ola] detamid kereva beshabbat.

Amar mar: veod kal vachomer, uma tamid sheen anush karet doche et hashshabbat, pesach sheanush karet — eno din sheddoche et hashshabbat. ikka lemifrach: ma letamid shekken tadir vechalil. kal vachomer amar lehu beresha ufarchu, vahadar amar lehu gezera shava.

Vechi meachar degamar gezera shava, kal vachomer lema li? ella ledidhu kaamar lehu: bishlama gezera shava la gamritu, deen adam dan gezera shava meatzmo. ella kal vachomer, deadam dan meatzmo, ibbei lechu lemedan! amaru leh: kal vachomer pericha hu.
Amar mar: lemachar mi sheppischo tale — tochev lo betzamro, gedi — tochev lo ben karnav.
b: Veha ka aved avoda bekadashim! kehillel. detanya, amru alav al hillel: miyyamav lo maal adam beolato. ella meviah chullin laazara umakdishah, vesomech yado aleha veshochatah.
Pesach beshabbat hechi matze makdesh leh, vehatnan: en makdishin veen maarichin veen machrimin veen magbihin teruma umaasrot. kol ellu beyom tov amru, kal vachomer bashshabbat!
Hane mille bechovot sheen kavua lahen zeman. aval bechovot shekkavua lahen zeman — makdishin. deamar rabbi yochanan: makdish adam et pischo beshabbat vachagigato beyom tov.
Vahalo mechammer! mechammer kilachar yad: mechammer kilachar yad name nehi deissura deorayyta lekka issura midderabbanan miha ikka.

Hayeynu deka bae minneh: davar sheyyesh lo hetter min hattora, udevar shevut omed lefanav, leokro kilachar yad bimkom mitzva may? amar lahen: halacha zo shamati veshachachti, ella hannichu lahen leyisrael, im en neviim hen — bene neviim hen.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hammityaher, im chacham hu — chochmato mistalleket mimmennu, im navi hu — nevuato mistalleket mimmennu. im chacham hu chochmato mistalleket mimmennu — mehillel, deamar mar hitchil mekanteran bidvarim, vekaamar lehu: halacha zo shamati veshachachti. im navi hu nevuato mistalleket mimmennu — middevora, dichtiv: "chadlu ferazon beyisrael chadellu ad shakkamti devora shakkamti em beyisrael vegomer", uchetiv: "uri uri devora uri uri dabberi shir vegomer".

Resh lakish amar: kol adam shekkoes, im chacham hu — chochmato mistalleket mimmennu, im navi hu — nevuato mistalleket mimmennu. im chacham hu chochmato mistalleket mimmennu — mimmoshe, dichtiv: "vayyiktzof moshe al pekude hechayil vegomer", uchetiv: "vayyomer elazar hakkohen el anshe hatztzava habbaim lammilchama zot chukkat hattora asher tzivva Adonai et moshe vegomer", mikkelal demoshe ialam minneh.

Im navi hu nevuato mistalleket mimmennu — meelisha, dichtiv: "lule pene yehoshafat melech yehuda ani nose im abbit elecha veim erekka vegomer", uchetiv: "veatta kechu li menaggen vehaya kenaggen hamenaggen vattehi alav yad Adonai vegomer".

Amar rabbi mani bar pattish: kol shekkoes, afillu poskin alav gedulla min hashshamayim — moridin oto. menalan? meeliav, shenneemar: "vayyichar af eliav bedavid vayyomer lamma [ze] yaradta veal mi natashta meat hatztzon hahenna bammidbar ani yadati et zedoncha veet roa levavecha ki lemaan reot hammilchama yaradta". vechi azal shemuel lemimshechinhu, bechullehu ketiv: "lo baze vachar Adonai", uveeliav ketiv: "vayyomer Adonai el shemuel al tabbet el marehu veel gevoah komato ki meastihu", mikkelal dahava rachem leh ad haiddana.
Ashkechan tamid ufesach dedachu shabbat, dedachu tumea mena lan? amri: ki hechi deyalef pesach mittamid leinyan shabbat, hachi name yalef tamid mippesach leinyan tumea.
Ufesach gufeh mena lan? amar rabbi yochanan: deamar kera "ish ish ki yihye tame lanefesh". ish nidche lefesach sheni, veen tzibbur nidchin lefesach sheni, ella avdi betumea.
Amar leh rabbi shimon ben lakish lerabbi yochanan: ema, ish nidche lefesach sheni, tzibbur let lehu takkanta la befesach rishon vela befesach sheni!

Ella amar rabbi shimon ben lakish, mehacha: "vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanafesh", yeamer temee metim veal yeamer zavin umetzorain, vaani omer: im temee metim, mishtalchin, zavin umetzorain — lo kol shekken?

a: Ella yesh lecha shaa shezzavin umetzorain mishtallechin veen temee metim mishtallechin, veeze ze — pesach habba betumea.

Amar abbaye: i hachi, lema name: yeamer zav utemee metim, veal yeamer metzora, vaani omer: zav mishtalleach, metzora — lo kol shekken. ella: yesh lecha shaa shemmetzorain mishtallechin, veen zavin utemee metim mishtallechin, veeze ze — pesach habba betumea.
Vechi tema hachi name, vehatnan: pesach habba betumea lo yochlu mimmennu zavim vezavot niddot veyoldot, veim achlu — peturin.
Ella amar abbaye: leolam mikkera kamma. im ken, nichtov rachamana: "ish ish ki yihye tame", "lanefesh" lema li?

Vechi tema hay "lanefesh" lehachi hu daata: hatteme met hu denidche lefesach sheni, aval shear temein la. vehatanya: yachol lo yehu osin pesach sheni ella temee metim veshehaya bederech rechoka, zavin umetzorain uvoale niddot minnayin? talmud lomar: "ish ish", "lanefesh" dichtav rachamana lema li?
Ella hachi kaamar: ish nidche lefesach sheni, veen tzibbur nidche lefesach sheni, ella avdi betumea. vechi avdi tzibbur betumea — bitme met, aval shear tumeot — la avdi.
Amar rav chisda: metzora shennichnas lefanim mimmechitzato patur, shenneemar: "badad yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo".
"Badad yeshev" — levaddo yeshev. "michutz lammachane moshavo", hakkatuv nitteko laase.
Etiveh: metzora shennichnas lifnim mimmechitzato — bearbaim. zavin vezavot shennichnesu lifnim mimmechitzatan — bearbaim. uteme met muttar likkanes lemachane leviyya.
Velo teme met bilvad amru, ella afillu met atzmo, shenneemar: "vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo" — "immo" bimchitzato!

Tannae hi, detanya: "badad yeshev" — levaddo yeshev, shello yehu temein acherim yoshvin immo. yachol yehu zavin utemee metim mishtallechin lemachane achat — talmud lomar: "velo yetammeu et machanehem", litten machane laze umachane laze, divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi shimon omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanefesh", yeamer temee met veal yeamer temee zav, vaani omer: temee metim mishtallechin, zavin — lo kol shekken. lamma neemar zav — litten lo machane sheniyya.
Veyeamer zav veal yeamer metzora, vaani omer: zavin mishtallechin, metzorain lo kol shekken? lamma neemar metzora — litten lo machane shelishit, keshehu omer "badad yeshev" — hakkatuv nitteko laase.
May chumereh dezav mitteme met? shekken tumea yotza alav miggufo. adderabba: teme met chamur, shekken taun hazzaa shelishi ushevii.
Amar kera "tame" "vechol tame", lerabbot teme sheretz. vezav chamur mitteme sheretz.
Umay chumereh? kedaamaran. adderabba: sheretz chamur, shekken metamme beones! amri:
b: Ki hay gavvna — zav name tammoye metamme beones kidrav huna. deamar rav huna: reiyya rishona shel zav metammea beones.
May chumereh dimtzora mizzav? shekken taun peria uferima, veasur betashmish hammitta. adderabba zav chamur, shekken metamme mishkav umoshav, umetamme keli cheres behesset.
Amar kera "zav", "vechol zav", lerabbot baal keri. umetzora chamur mibbaal keri.
Umay chumereh — kedaamaran. adderabba: baal keri chamur, shekken metamme bemashshehu!
Savar la kerabbi natan. detanya: rabbi natan omer mishshum rabbi yishmael: zav tzarich kachatimat pi haamma, velo hodu lo chachamim. veittakkash leh baal keri lezav.
"Vechol tzarua" lema li? ayyeyde dichtiv "kol zav", ketiv name "kol tzarua".
Verabbi yehuda, shappir kaamar rabbi shimon?

Hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya, rabbi eliezer omer: yachol dachaku zavin umetzorain venichnesu laazara befesach habba betumea, yachol yehu chayyayvin, talmud lomar: "vishallechu min hammachane kol tzarua vechol zav vechol tame lanefesh". beshaa shettemee metim mishtallechin — zavin umetzorain mishtallechin, en temee metim mishtallechin — en zavin umetzorain mishtallechin.
Amar mar: "zav", "vechol zav" — lerabbot baal keri. mesayyay leh lerabbi yochanan. deamar rabbi yochanan: mechillot lo nitkaddeshu, uvaal keri mishtalleach chutz lishte machanot.
Metivi: baal keri kemagga sheretz, may lav lemachanotam? lo, letumeatam.
Letumeatam?! hay tumeat erev ketiv beh, vehay tumeat erev ketiv beh! ella lav, lemachanotam!
La, leolam letumeatam, veha kamashma lan devaal keri kemagga sheretz: ma magga sheretz metamme beones — af baal keri metamme beones.
Metivi:

a: Boel nidda kitme met. lemay? ilema letumeatam, hay tumeat shiva ketiv beh, vehay tumeat shiva ketiv beh.
Ella lav, lemachanotam. umiddesefa lemachanotam have — resha name lemachanotam! midde irya?! ha kidita veha kidita.
Metivi: metzora chamur mizzav, vezav chamur mitteme met, yatza baal keri shetteme met chamur mimmennu.
May yatza? lav: yatza mikkelal zav uva lichlal teme met, deha teme met chamur mimmennu — umuttar bemachane leviyya!
Lo, yatza mimmachane teme met venichnas lemachane zav, veaf al gav ditme met chamur mimmennu (demuttar) bemachane leviyya — lemay dedame leh medammenan leh.

Tane tanna kammeh derav yitzchak bar avdimi: "veyatza el michutz lammachane" — zo machane shechina. "lo yavo el toch hammachane" — zo machane leviyya. mikkan levaal keri sheyyetze chutz lishte machanot.
Amar leh: akkatti la ayyelteh, appekteh. lishshana acharina: akkatti la appekteh, ayyelteh. ella ema: "michutz lammachane" — zo machane leviyya. "la yavo el toch hammachane" — zo machane shechina.

Matkef la ravina: ema idde veidde lemachane shechina, velaavor alav baase velo taase! im ken, lema kera: "veyatza el michutz lammachane velo yavo el toch", "hammachane" lema li? shema minna litten lo machane acheret.
Umichuy keravav vechulei. may michuy keravav? rav huna amar: shemmenakkevan besakkin. (rav) chiyyay bar rav amar: shirka dimiyyay denafka aggav ducheka desakkina.
Amar rabbi (eliezer): may tama dechiyyay bar rav? dichtiv: "vechorvot mechim garim yochelu", may mashma? kedimtargem rav yosef "venichsehon derashshiayya tzaddikayya yachsenun".

"Verau chevasim kedovram", amar menashsheya bar yirmeya amar rav: kamdubbar bam. may kamdubbar bam? amar abbaye: "vechorvot mechim garim yochelu". amar leh rava: bishlama i ketiv "chorvot" — kidkaamrat, hasheta dichtiv "vechorvot", milleta achariti kaamar.

Ella amar rava: kidrav chananel amar rav. deamar rav chananel amar rav: atidin tzaddikim sheyyechayyu et hammetim. ketiv hacha: "verau chevasim kedovram", uchetiv hatam: "yiru vashan vegilad kime olam".

Bashan — ze elisha habba min habbashan, shenneemar: "veyanay veshafat babbashan", uchetiv: "po elisha ben shafat asher yatzak mayim al yede eliyyahu". gilad — ze eliyyahu, shenneemar: "vayyomer eliyyahu hattishbi mittoshave gilad vegomer".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: atidim tzaddikim sheyyechayyu metim, shenneemar: "od yeshvu zekenim uzekenot birchovot yerushalaym veish mishanto beyado merov yamim", uchetiv: "vesamta mishanti al pene hannaar".

Ulla rame, ketiv: "billa hammavet lanetzach", uchetiv: "ki hannaar ben mea shana yamut"! la kashya: kan beyisrael, kan baggoyim. vegoyim may bau hatam? dichtiv: "veamdu zarim verau tzonchem uvene nechar ikkarechem vechormechem".

Rav chisda rame, ketiv: "vechafra hallevana uvosha hachamma", uchetiv: "vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim keor shivat hayyamim"! la kashya: kan laolam habba, kan limot hammashiach.
Velishmuel deamar: en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud malchiyyot bilvad, may ikka lememar? idde veidde laolam habba, vela kashya: kan — bemachane shechina, kan — bemachane tzaddikim.

Rava rame, ketiv: "ani amit vaachayye", uchetiv: "machatzti vaani erpa". hasheta achoye machaye, merappe lo kol shekken! ella, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ma sheani memit — ani mechayye, kemo shemmachatzti — vaani erpa.

Tanu rabbanan: "ani amit vaachayye" yachol mita beechad vechayyim beechad, kederech shehaolam noheg, talmud lomar: "machatzti vaani erpa", ma makka urefua beechad, af mita vechayyim beechad. mikkan teshuva laomrim en techiyyayt hammetim min hattora. davar acher: battechilla ma sheani memit ani mechayye, vahadar ma shemmachatzti vaani erpa.
b: Vehekter chalavav vechulei. tanya amar rabbi shimon: bo uree kamma chaviva mitzva bishatah, shehare hekter chalavim veevarim ufedarim kesherim kol hallayla, veen mamtinim lahem ad shettechshach.
Harekavato vahavaato vechulei. ureminhu: chotchin yabbelet bammikdash, aval lo bammedina. veim bichli — kan vechan asur.
Rabbi elazar verabbi yose bar chanina, chad amar: idde veidde bayyad; ha belacha, ha bivesha. vechad amar: idde veidde belacha, vela kashya: ha bayyad, ha bichli.
Uleman deamar: ha bayyad, ha bichli — may tama la amar: idde veidde bayyad, vela kashya: ha belacha ha bivesha? amar lach: yevesha — mifrach pericha.

Uleman deamar: idde veidde bayyad, vela kashya: ha belacha, ha bivesha — may tama la amar: idde veidde belacha, vela kashya: ha bayyad, ha bichli? amar lach: keli — ha katane hatam: im bichli, kan vechan asur.
Veiddach? ha dekatane keli hacha, pelugeta derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua ata leashmoinan.
Amar rabbi eliezer uma im shechita vechulei. rabbi yehoshua letameh deamar simchat yom tov name mitzva hi.
Detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: en lo leadam beyom tov ella, o ochel veshote, o yoshev veshone. rabbi yehoshua omer: challekehu, chetzyo laachila ushetiyya, vechetzyo levet hammidrash.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: ushenehem mikra echad darshu, katuv echad omer: "atzeret laAdonai elohecha", vechatuv echad omer: "atzeret tihye lachem". rabbi eliezer savar: o kullo laAdonai, o kullo lachem. verabbi yehoshua savar: challekehu, chetzyo laAdonai vechetzyo lachem.

(112 Siman) amar rabbi elazar: hakkol modim baatzeret devaenan name lachem. may tama? yom shennittena bo tora hu. amar rabba: hakkol modim beshabbat devaenan name lachem. may tama? "vekarata lashshabbat oneg". amar rav yosef: hakkol modim befurim devaenan name lachem. may tama? "yeme mishte vesimcha" ketiv beh.

Mar bereh deravina kulla shatta hava yatev betaanita, levar meatzarta, ufureya, umaale yoma dechippure. atzeret — yom shennittena bo tora. pureya — "yeme mishte vesimcha" ketiv. maale yoma dechippure — detane chiyyay bar rav middifti: "veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha lachodesh", vechi betisha (hem) mitannin? vahalo baasiri mitannin! ella lomar lecha: kol haochel veshote betisha bo — maale alav hakkatuv keillu mitanne teshii vaasiri.
Rav yosef beyoma daatzarta amar: avdi li igla tilta. amar, i la hay yoma deka garem — kamma yosef ikka beshuka.

Rav sheshet kol telatin yomin mehaddar leh talmudeh, vetale vekae beivra dedashsha, vaamar: chaday nafshay, chaday nafshay, lach keray lach tenay. ini? vehaamar rabbi elazar: ilmale tora lo nitkayyeymu shamayim vaaretz, shenneemar: "im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti"! meikkara ki aved inish — addata denafsheh ka aved.

Amar rav ashe: ulemay dekaamar rabbi eliezer name yom tov reshut, it leh pircha: uma yom tov shehittir bo melacha shel reshut, lo hittir shevut sheimmah. shabbat shello hittir bah ella melacha shel mitzva — eno din shello tattir shevut sheimmah!

a: Verabbi eliezer, shevut demitzva adif leh.
Tanya amar rabbi eliezer: uma li im dachu machshire mitzva shelleachar shechita et hashshabbat, deitavid leh mitzva — lo yidchu machshire mitzva shellifne shechita et hashshabbat!

Amar lo rabbi akiva: dema li im dachu machshire mitzva shelleachar shechita et hashshabbat, shehare dachata shechita et hashshabbat, tomar yidchu machshire mitzva shellifne shechita et hashshabbat — shello dachata shechita et hashshabbat. davar acher: shemma yimmatze zevach pasul, venimtza mechallel et hashshabbat lemafrea.
I hachi — mishchat name la nishchot, shemma yimmatze zevach pasul, venimtza mechallel et hashshabbat lemafrea. ella: ha amar leh beresha ufarcheh, vahadar amar leh hach dema li im dachu.

Heshiv rabbi akiva veamar: hazzaa tochiach vechulei. tanya, amar lo rabbi eliezer: akiva, bishchita heshavtani, bishchita tehe mitato. amar lo: rabbi, al tachpireni bishat haddin, kach mekubbelani mimmecha: hazzaa shevut hi, veenah docha et hashshabbat.
Vechi meachar dehu agmereh, may tama ka hadar beh? amar ulla: rabbi eliezer ki agmereh, hazzaa ditruma agmereh — ditruma gufa la dachaya shabbat.
Rabbi akiva name ki otveh — hazzaa ditruma otveh, shehi mitzva vehi mishshum shevut! vehu savar: hazzaa defesach ka motev leh.
Metiv rabba: heshiv rabbi akiva veamar: hazzaat teme met tochiach, shechal shevii shello lihyot bashshabbat, uveerev happesach shehi mitzva, vehi mishshum shevut — veenah docha et hashshabbat.

Ella, vavday hazzaa defesach agmereh. vechi meachar deagmereh, may tama ka parech leh rabbi eliezer? rabbi eliezer gemareh itakar leh, vaata rabbi akiva leadkore gemareh. venema leh behedya! savar, lav orach ara.
Vehazzaa may tama la dachaya shabbat? mikkede taltole bealma hu, tiddeche shabbat mishshum pesach! amar rabba: gezera shemma yittelenna veyaavirenna arba ammot birshut harabbim.

Ulerabbi eliezer naybereh! deha amar rabbi eliezer: machshire mitzva dochin et hashshabbat! amri: hane mille hecha degavra gufeh chaze ureme chiyyuva aleh. aval hacha, degavra gufeh la chaze — la reme chiyyuva aleh.
Amar rabba: ledivre rabbi eliezer, katan bari — mechammin lo chammin lehaveroto ulemulo beshabbat, deha chaze leh. katan chole — en mechammin lo chammin lehaveroto ulemulo, deha la chaze leh.

Amar rava: vei bari hu lema leh chammin lehaveroto? ella amar rava: hakkol cholin hen etzel milla, echad katan bari veechad katan chole en mechammin lo chammin lehaveroto ulemulo beshabbat, deha la chaze.
Etiveh abbaye: arel shello mal anush karet, divre rabbi eliezer. veha hacha degavra gufeh la chaze, vekatane anush karet, alma: reme chiyyuva aleh!
Amar rabba: kasavar rabbi eliezer, en shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz.
b: Vechol sheillu beyachid nidche, betzibbur avdi betumea. vechol milleta deita betzibbur, ita beyachid. vechol milleta deleta betzibbur, leta beyachid.
Arelut, dei kulleh tzibbur arelim ninhu, amrinan lehu: kumu mehulu nafshayychu vaavide pischa. yachid name, amrinan leh: kum mehol vaaved pischa. vei la mahel veaved — anush karet.
Tumea, dei kulleh tzibbura temein ninhu — la maddenan alayyhu, ella avdi betumea, yachid name patur.
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava: vahare pesach sheni, deleteh betzibbur veiteh beyachid! amar leh: shane hatam deha avad leh tzibbura berishon.
Metivi: yachol lo yehe anush karet ella shehaya tahor veshello haya bederech rechoka. arel uteme sheretz ushear kol hattemeim minnayin? talmud lomar: "vehaish".

Middeka mehaddar atteme sheretz, kasavar: en shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz, dei shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz — lema leh leahadore aleh, hayeynu tahor. alma: af al gav dela chaze — chiyyuva aleh, veaf al gav deleteh betzibbur — iteh beyachid.
Ella amar rava: kasavar rabbi eliezer shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz, vehu haddin litme met bishvii shello. hazzaa lemay? laachila achilat pesachim la meakkeva!
Amar leh rav adda bar abba lerava: im ken, nimtza pesach nishchat shello leochlav. amar leh: shello leochlav — lechole ulezaken, dela chaze. aval hay — michze chaze, takkone hu dela metakkan.

Kelal amar rabbi akiva vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar rav: halacha kerabbi akiva. utenan name gabbe mila ki hay gavvna, kelal amar rabbi akiva: kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat — enah docha et hashshabbat, mila shei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat — docha et hashshabbat. veamar rav yehuda amar rav: halacha kerabbi akiva.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan gabbe fesach: hatam (dehu machshire) mitzva la dachu shabbat, mishshum delo nichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot. aval mila, denichretu aleha shelosh esre beritot, ema lidche.
Vei ashmeinan mila: hatam hu demachshire mitzva la dachu shabbat, delekka karet, aval pesach deikka karet, ema lidche. tzericha.
Mishna ematay mevi chagiga immo? bizman shehu ba bachol, betohora uvemuat. uvizman shehu ba beshabbat, bimrubbe uvetumea — en meviin immo chagiga.
Chagiga hayta baa min hatztzon min habbakar, min hakkevasim umin haizzim, min hazzecharim umin hannekevot, veneechelet lishne yamim velayla echad.

Gemara may tanna dekatane chagiga? tana harekavato vahavaato dela dache shabbat, vekatane name chagiga dela dachaya shabbat. vehachi kaamar: ematay meviin immo chagiga — bizman shehu ba bechol, betohora uvemuat.
Amar rav ashe: shema minna chagigat arbaa asar

a: Lav chova hi. dei salka datach chova hi — tete beshabbat, vetete bimrubbe, vetete betumea.
Uvemuat mihu may tama atya? kidtanya: chagiga habbaa im happesach neechelet techilla, kede sheyyehe pesach neechol al hassava.

Veneechelet lishne yamim vechulei. matnitin dela keven tema. detanya, ben tema omer: chagiga habbaa im happesach hare hi kappesach, veenah neechelet ella leyom valayla. vachagigat chamishsha asar — neechelet lishne yamim velayla echad.
Vachagigat arbaa asar yotze bah mishshum simcha, veen yotze bah mishshum chagiga.
May tama deven tema? kidmatne rav lechiyyay bereh: "velo yalin labboker zevach chag happasach", "zevach chag" — ze chagiga, "happasach" — kemashmao, veamar rachamana: "lo yalin".
Ibbaya lehu: leven tema neechelet tzali o en neechelet tzali? ki akkesheh rachamana lefesach — lelina, aval letzali — la, o dilma la shena?
Ta shema: hallayla hazze kullo tzali. veamar rav chisda: zo divre ben tema. shema minna.
Ibbaya lehu leven tema: baa min habbakar o enah baa min habbakar, baa min hannekevot o enah baa min hannekevot, baa bat shete shanim o enah baa bat shete shanim?
Ki akkesheh rachamana lefesach — lemidde daachila, aval lechol mille — la, o dilma la shena.

Ta shema: chagiga habbaa im happesach hare hi kefesach, baa min hatztzon veenah baa min habbakar, baa min hazzecharim veenah baa min hannekevot, baa bat shenatah veenah baa bat shete shanim, veenah neechelet ella leyom valayla, veenah neechelet ella tzali, veenah neechelet ella limnuyav.
Man shamat leh deit leh hay sevara — ben tema, shema minna kullehu milleta baenan, shema minna.

Ibbaya lehu leven tema: yesh bah mishshum shevirat etzem, o en bah mishshum shevirat haetzem? af al gav dechi akkesheh rachamana lefesach, amar kera: "bo". "bo" — velo bachagiga. o dilma, hay "bo" — bechasher velo befasul hu daata.
Ta shema: sakkin shennimtzet bearbaa asar — shochet bah miyyad. bishlosha asar — shone umatbil. kofitz ben baze uven baze — shone umatbil.
Manni? illema rabbanan, may shena sakkin dematbil — dechazya lefesach, kofitz name — ha chaze lachagiga.
Ella lav, deven tema hi, ushema minna yesh bah mishshum shevirat haetzem.
La, leolam rabbanan, uchegon shebba bashshabbat.

Veha middekatane sefa: chal arbaa asar lihyot beshabbat — shochet bah miyyad, uvachamishsha asar — shochet bah miyyad. nimtzet kofitz keshura lesakkin — hare hi kassakkin. mikkelal deresha lav beshabbat askinan.
Veella shebba
b: Bimrubbe. mena yadi?
Veella shebba betumea. sof sof, mena yadi?
Demit nasi. demit nasi emat? illema demit bishlosha asar — sakkin lema li dematbeleh? veella demit bearbaa asar. may shena sakkin dematbel, umay shena kofitz dela matbel le?
La tzericha, denasi goses bishlosha asar. sakkin, dechad sefeka — matbel le. kofitz, ditre sefeke — la matbel le.

Tanya, yehuda ben dortay perash hu vedortay beno, vehalach veyashav lo baddarom. amar: im yavo eliyyahu veyomar lahem leyisrael: mippene ma lo chagagtem chagiga bashshabbat, ma hen omrim lo? temehani al shene gedole haddor shemaya veavtalyon shehen chachamim gedolim vedarshanin gedolim, velo amru lahen leyisrael chagiga docha et hashshabbat.

Amar rav: may tama deven dortay, dichtiv: "vezavachta pesach laAdonai elohecha tzon uvakar", vahalo en pesach ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim! ella: "tzon" — ze pesach, "bakar" — zo chagiga, veamar rachamana "vezavachta pesach"!
Amar rav ashe: vaanan tama difrushim neku venifrosh? ella kera lechidrav nachman hu daata, deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: minnayin lemotar happesach shekkarev shelamim —

Shenneemar: "vezavachta pesach laAdonai elohecha tzon uvakar". vechi pesach min habbakar ba? vahalo en pesach ba ella min hakkevasim umin haizzim! ella motar happesach yehe ledavar habba min hatztzon umin habbakar.
Verabbanan, may tama la dache shabbat? ha vadday korban tzibbur hu!
Amar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi yehuda ben safra, amar kera: "vechaggotem oto chag laAdonai shivat yamim bashshana". shiva? shemona havo! ella mikkan lachagiga sheenah docha et hashshabbat.

Ki ata ravin amar: amarti lifne rabbotay: peamim shei atta motze ella shishsha, kegon shechal yom tov harishon shel chag bashshabbat! amar abbaye: avin takkala lema ki ha milleta? shemona la mashkachat la kelal, shiva ita berov shanim.
Amar ulla amar rabbi elazar: shelamim sheshshechatan meerev yom tov, eno yotze bahen lo mishshum simcha velo mishshum chagiga. mishshum simcha, dichtiv: "vezavachta ... vesamachta" — baenan zevicha

a: Bishat simcha, velekka. mishshum chagiga: have davar shebbechova, vechol davar shebbechova eno ba ella min hachullin.
Lema mesayyay leh: "vehayita ach sameach" — lerabbot lele yom tov haacharon lesimcha. atta omer lele yom tov haacharon, o eno ella lele yom tov harishon? talmud lomar: "ach (sameach)" — chalak.
May tama? lav mishshum deen lo bamme yismach!

La, kidtane tama: ma raita lerabbot lele yom tov haacharon ulehotzi lele yom tov rishon? merabbe ani lele yom tov haacharon sheyyesh simcha lefanav, umotzi ani lele yom tov rishon sheen simcha lefanav.
Metiv rav yosef: chagigat arbaa asar yotze bah mishshum simcha, veen yotze bah mishshum chagiga. ammay? ha baenan zevicha bishat simcha, velekka! amar rav idi bar avin: sheikkev ushechatah.
Amar rav ashe: hachi name mistabbera, dei la tema hachi, ha matnita man katane la? ben tema — ben tema ha pasla la belina! shema minna.

Metiv rava: hahallel vehassimcha shemona. vei amrat baenan zevicha bishat simcha, ha zimnin saggiin dela mashkachat la ella shiva, kegon shechal yom tov harishon lihyot beshabbat! amar rav huna bereh derav yehuda: mesammecho bisire hargalim.

Amar rava, shete teshuvot baddavar: chada, disire hargalim chay neechalin tzali en neechalin, vesimcha bechay lekka. veod, kohanim ochlin veyisrael bamme semechim? ella amar rav pappa: mesammecho bichsut nekiyya veyayin yashan.

Ki ata ravin amar rabbi elazar: shelamim sheshshechatan meerev yom tov yotze bahen mishshum simcha veen yotze bahen mishshum chagiga. yotze mishshum simcha — la baenan zevicha bishat simcha. vela mishshum chagiga — have davar shebbechova, vechol davar shebbechova eno ba ella min hachullin.
Metivi: "vehayita ach sameach" — lerabbot lele yom tov haacharon lesimcha. atta omer lerabbot lele yom tov haacharon, o eno ella lerabbot lele yom tov harishon? talmud lomar "ach" — chalak.

May tama? lav mishshum deen lo bamme yismach! lo, kidtanya: ma raita lerabbot lele yom tov haacharon ulehotzi lele yom tov harishon? merabbe ani lele yom tov haacharon sheyyesh simcha lefanav, umotzi ani lele yom tov harishon sheen simcha lefanav.
Amar rav kahana: minnayin leemure chagigat chamishsha asar shennifsalin belina? shenneemar: "velo yalin chelev chaggi ad boker", usemich leh "reshit" lememra dehay boker — boker rishon.
Matkef la rav yosef: tama dichtav "reshit", ha la ketav "reshit" hava amena may boker — boker sheni. mi ikka midde devasar ippesil leh meureta, veemurin ad tzafra?
Amar leh abbaye: allema la? vahare pesach lerabbi elazar ben azarya, devasar ippesil leh mechatzot, veemurin ad tzafra!
Amar rava, rav yosef hachi ka kashya leh: mi ikka midde deillu tanna levasar la bae "reshit", verav kahana leemurin bae "reshit"?
May hi? detanya: "lo yalin min habbasar asher tizbach baerev bayyom harishon labboker",
b: Limmed al chagigat arbaa asar shenneechelet lishne yamim velayla echad. o eno ella leyom valayla? keshehu omer: "beyom harishon labboker" — hare boker sheni amur.

O eno ella boker rishon, uma ani mekayyem chagiga hanneechelet lishne yamim valayla echad — chutz mizzo, keshehu omer bo: "im neder o nedava" — limmed al chagigat arbaa asar shenneechelet lishne yamim valayla echad.

Amar mar: o eno ella boker rishon. ha amarta: keshehu omer "bayyom harishon (labboker)" — hare boker sheni amur? hachi kaamar: o eno ella bishte chagigot hakkatuv medabber, achat chagigat arbaa asar veachat chagigat chamishsha asar, vezo levokrah vezo levokrah.

Hadar amar: ella dekayyma lan chagiga hanneechelet lishne yamim valayla echad. im ken: "im neder o nedava" bemay? i chagigat arbaa asar, ha ketiv ba yom valayla! i chagigat chamishsha asar, ha ketiv ba yom valayla!
Ella, hay lachagigat chamishsha asar, vehaych kulleh kera lachagigat arbaa asar, limmed al chagigat arbaa asar shenneechelet lishne yamim valayla echad.
Tama dichtiv "bayyom harishon labboker", demay "boker" — boker sheni. ha kol hecha dichtiv boker setama — boker rishon, veaf al gav dela ketav beh "reshit".
Mishna happesach sheshshechato shello lishmo beshabbat — chayyayv alav chattat.
Ushear kol hazzevachim sheshshechatan leshem pesach, im enan reuyin — chayyayv, veim reuyin hen — rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter.

Amar leh rabbi eliezer: ma im happesach shehu muttar lishmo, kesheshshinna et shemo — chayyayv, zevachim shehen asurin lishman, kesheshshinna et sheman — eno din sheyyehe chayyayv? amar leh rabbi yehoshua: la, im amarta bappesach sheshshinnahu bedavar asur, tomar bizvachim sheshshinnan bedavar hammuttar.

Amar leh rabbi eliezer: emure tzibbur yochichu, shehen muttarin lishman, vehashshochet lishman chayyayv. amar leh rabbi yehoshua: lo, im amarta beemure tzibbur sheyyesh lahen kitzva, tomar bappesach sheen lo kitzva.
Rabbi meir omer: af hashshochet leshem emure tzibbur — patur.
Shechato shello leochlav veshello limnuyav, laarelin velitmein — chayyayv. leochlav veshello leochlav, limnuyav veshello limnuyav, lemulin velaarelim, litmein velithorin — patur.
Shechato venimtza baal mum — chayyayv. shechato venimtza terefa basseter — patur.
Shechato venoda shemmashchu habbealim et yadam, o shemmetu o shennitmeu — patur, mippene sheshshachat birshut.

a: Gemara bemay askinan? ilema betoe — shamat minna akira betaut havya akira. ella beoker.

Ema sefa: ushear kol hazzevachim sheshshechatan leshum happesach, im enan reuyin — chayyayv, im reuyin hen — rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter. vei beoker, ma li reuyin, ma li sheenan reuyin?
Ella peshita betoe. resha beoker vesefa betoe! amar rabbi avin: in, resha beoker vesefa betoe.

Ashkecheh rav yitzchak bar yosef lerabbi avahu dahava kae beuchelusa deinashe, amar leh: matnitin may? amar leh: resha beoker vesefa betoe. tena minneh arbein zimnin vedame leh keman demannecha bechiseh.

Tenan amar rabbi eliezer: ma im pesach shemmuttar lishmo, kesheshshinna et shemo — chayyayv, zevachim shehen asurin lishman, kesheshshinna et sheman eno din sheyyehe chayyayv! veim ita, ha la dame, deresha beoker, vesefa betoe!
Lerabbi eliezer la shane leh. lerabbi yehoshua deshane leh, lishanne leh hachi!
Hachi kaamar leh: ledidi la dame, resha beoker vesefa betoe. ledidach: lo im amarta befesach sheshshinna et shemo ledavar haasur, tomar bizvachim sheshshinna et sheman ledavar hammuttar.

Amar leh rabbi eliezer: emure tzibbur yochichu shehen muttarin lishman, vehashshochet lishman — chayyayv, amar lo rabbi yehoshua: lo im amarta beemure tzibbur shekken yesh lahen kitzva, tomar befesach sheen lo kitzva.

Lememra dechol hecha deit leh kitzva mechayyev rabbi yehoshua? vahare tinokot, deyesh lahen kitzva, utenan: mi shehayu lo shene tinokot, echad lemulo achar hashshabbat veechad lemulo bashshabbat, veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat — chayyayv.
Echad lemulo beerev shabbat, veechad lamul bashshabbat, veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat — rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter!
Amar rabbi amme: hacha bemay askinan? kegon shekkadam umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat, deikka hach deshabbat ditrid beh. hacha, kegon shekkadam veshachtinhu leemure tzibbur beresha.

I hachi? rabbi meir omer: af hashshochet leshem emure tzibbur patur, af al gav dikdem veshachtinhu leemure tzibbur beresha, vehattanya, rabbi chiyyay [meavel arav] amar rabbi meir: lo nechleku rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua al shehayu lo shene tinokot, echad lamul erev shabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat, veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat bashshabbat — dechayyayv.

Al ma nechleku — al shehayu lo shene tinokot, echad lamul achar hashshabbat veechad lamul bashshabbat, veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat bashshabbat, derabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter.
Vetisbera: ma hatam dela aved mitzva — patar rabbi yehoshua, hecha deka aved mitzva — mechayyev?!
Amri deve rabbi yannay: resha — kegon shekkadam umal shel shabbat beerev shabbat,
b: Shello nittena shabbat liddachot. [vesefa — nittena shabbat liddachot etzlo].
Hacha — hare nittena shabbat liddachot etzel korban tzibbur.
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: hacha name, hare nittena shabbat liddachot etzel tinokot dealma! amar leh: legabbe dehay gavra mihat la ityehiv.

Ushear kol hazzevachim sheshshechatan leshum pesach, im enan reuyin — chayyayv, veim reuyin — rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter. man tanna deshane leh ben reuyin lesheenan reuyin?

Rabbi shimon hi. detanya: echad hazzevachim haruyin veechad zevachim sheenan reuyin, vechen hashshochet leshem emure tzibbur — patur, divre rabbi meir. amar rabbi shimon: lo nechleku rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua al sheenan reuyin shechayyayv, al ma nechleku — al haruyin, sherabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter.

Amar rav bivi amar rabbi elazar: poter haya rabbi meir afillu egel shel zivche shelamim sheshshechato leshum happesach. amar leh rabbi zera lerav bivi: vehaamar rabbi yochanan: mode haya rabbi meir bevaale mumin! amar leh: bevaale mumin la terid behu, vehay terid beh.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: chullin leshum pesach, may li amar rabbi meir? amar leh: poter haya rabbi meir afillu chullin leshum pesach.
Vehaamar rabbi yochanan: mode haya rabbi meir bevaale mumin! baale mumin la michallefi, hane michallefi.

Vetama derabbi meir mishshum ichallofe vela ichallofe? vehaamar rav bivi amar rabbi elazar: poter haya rabbi meir afillu egel shel zivche shelamim sheshshechato leshum happesach! alma, tama derabbi meir mishshum ditrid!
Amar leh: terid — af al gav dela michallaf, michallaf — af al gav dela terid, leappoke baale mumin, dela ichallofe michallaf vela mitrid terid.

Yatev rabbi zera verabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak akkila derabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak, veyatvi veka amri, amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: nitchallef lo shappud shel notar beshappud shel tzali, vaachalo — chayyayv.
Verabbi yochanan amar: ishto nidda baal — chayyayv. yevimto nidda baal — patur.
Ikka deamri: kol shekken behahi demichayyayv, delo asa mitzva.
It deamri, behahi — patur. may tama? hatam hu dahava leh leshayyole. aval hacha, dela hava leh leshayyole — la.
Verabbi yochanan, may shena yevimto, deka aved mitzva? ishto name ka aved mitzva! beishto meubberet.
Veha ikka simchat ona! shello bishat onatah.
Vehaamar rava: chayyayv adam lesammeach ishto bidvar mitzva! samuch levivstah.
I hachi, afillu yevimto name! yevimto beziz minna, ishto la beziz minna.

Verabbi yochanan keman? illema kerabbi yose. ditnan, rabbi yose omer: yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot bashshabbat, veshachach vehotzi et hallulav lirshut harabbim — patur, mippene shehotzi birshut.
Dilma shane hatam, dizmanno bahul.
Veella rabbi yehoshua dizvachim. dilma hatam name zemanno bahul.
Veella kerabbi yehoshua detinokot. hatam name zemanno bahul.
Veella kerabbi yehoshua ditruma, ditnan: haya ochel bitruma venoda shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza — rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vachomesh, rabbi yehoshua poter.
Dilma kidrav bivi bar abbaye, deamar rav bivi bar abbaye: bitruma beerev happesach, dizmannah bahul.
I name: shane teruma deikkeri avoda, vaavoda rachamana achshar.

Ditnan: haya omed umakriv, venoda shehu ben gerusha o ben chalutza — kol hakkarbanot kullan shehikriv al gabbe hammizbeach pesulin, verabbi yehoshua machshir. veamrinan, may tama derabbi yehoshua — dichtiv: "barech Adonai chelo ufoal yadav tirtze".

Uteruma hecha ikkeri avoda? detanya, maase berabbi tarfon shello ba emesh levet hammidrash. leshacharit metzao rabban gamliel, amar lo: mippene ma lo bata emesh levet hammidrash? amar lo: avoda avadti. amar lo: kol devarecha enan ella divre tema, vechi avoda bazzeman hazze minnayin? amar lo, hare hu omer:

a: "Avodat mattana etten et kehunnatchem vehazzar hakkarev yumat", asu achilat teruma bigvulin kaavodat bet hammikdash.
Shechato shello leochlav. peshita! kevan dehatam — pasul, hacha — chayyayv! mishshum detanna sefa patur, tena resha chayyayv.

Veha name peshita, mishshum dehatam kasher, hacha patur! ella, ayyeyde ditna shechato shello lishmo beshabbat, tena name shello leochlav. vehi gufa lema li? mishshum dekavae leippeloge rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua.
Amar leh rav huna bar chinnana livreh: ki azlat lekammeh derabbi zerika, bae minneh: ledivre haomer "mekalkel bechabbura — patur", "shechato shello leochlav — chayyayv"? ma tikken?!
Tikken im alu lo yerdu.
Shechato venimtza baal mum chayyayv, ma tikken? tikken bedukkin shebbaayin, veallibba derabbi akiva deamar im alu lo yerdu.
Shechato venimtza terefa basseter — patur. ha begaluy — chayyayv. ma tikken? tikken lehotzi mide nevela.
Matkef la ravina: ha detanya: hashshochet chattat bashshabbat bachutz laavoda zara — chayyayv aleha shalosh chattaot, ma tikken?
Amar rav avvira: shemmotzio mide ever min hachay.
Shechato venoda vechulei. amar rav huna amar rav: asham shennittak liriyya, ushechato setam — kasher laola. alma kasavar: la bae akira.
I hachi ki lo nittak name! gezera leachar kappara attu lifne chappara.

Umena temra, ditnan: asham shemmetu bealav o shennitkapperu bealav — yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava. rabbi eliezer omer: yamut. rabbi yehoshua omer: yimmacher veyavi bedamav ola.
Bedamav in, aval gufo la. degazar leachar kappara attu lifne kappara. shema minna.
Etiveh rav chisda lerav huna: shechato venoda shemmashchu bealim et yadam vechulei,
b: Vetane ala: bachol ki hay gavna yissaref miyyad. i amrat bishlama bae akira, hay pesach hu, vechevan delet leh bealim — have leh pesulo begufo, ammetu lehachi yissaref miyyad.
Ella i amrat la bae akira — meresha have leh shelamim, pesulo mishshum may — mishshum davar acher, deka shachet leh achar tamid shel ben haarbayim. ibbur tzura bae.
Detanya, ze hakkelal: kol sheppesulo begufo — yissaref miyyad. baddam uvabbealim — teubbar tzurato veyetze levet hasserefa!
Ella la tema shechato setam — kasher leshum ola, ella ema shechato leshum ola — kasher. alma bae akira.
Ulerabbi chiyyay bar gammada, deamar: nizreka mippi chavura veamri, kegon shehayu bealim temee metim venidchin lefesach sheni.
Hay hu devae akira, ha bealma la bae akira. may ikka lememar?
Ella amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hacha bemay askinan — kegon shehifrisho kodem chatzot, umetu bealim achar chatzot, dehave leh nire venidche. vechol hannire venidche — shuv eno chozer venire.
Midde hu tama ella lerav, ha amar rav: baale chayyim enam nidchim.
Ella amar rav pappa: ha manni? rabbi eliezer hi, deamar: vechen hashshochet acherim leshem pesach — pasul, dehave leh pesulo begufo.
Vei rabbi eliezer hi, chattat name michayyayv, deha let leh lerabbi eliezer toe bidvar mitzva patur?

Ella, targema rav yosef bereh derav salla chasida kammeh derav pappa: ha manni yosef ben chonay hi. ditnan, yosef ben chonay omer: hannishchatim leshem pesach uleshem chattat — pesulim, alma: pesulo begufo hi, umishshum hachi yissaref miyyad, uviftore — savar la kerabbi yehoshua.

Rav ashe amar: rav deamar kerabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka. detanya, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: im yesh shehut beyom leda im mashchu bealim et yedehem o shemmetu o shennitmeu — chayyayv, uteubbar tzurato veyotze levet hasserefa. may tama? lav mishshum dela bae akira!
Mimmay? dilma mishshum desavar la ketanna deve rabba bar avu, deamar: afillu piggul name bae ibbur tzura. deyalef "avon" "avon" minnotar.
Dei la tema hachi, nitmeu bealim may ikka lememar? ha vadday bae akira, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar gammada: nizreka mippi chavura, kegon shehayu bealim temee met venidchu lefesach sheni.
Ella mechavvavrta kidshanni meikkara: yosef ben chonay hi.
Hadran alach ellu devarim

a: Mishna ketzad tzolin et happesach? meviin shappud shel rimmon, vetochavo letoch piv ad bet nekuvato, venoten et keraav veet bene meav letocho, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer: kemin bishshul hu ze, ella tolin chutza lo. en tzolin et happesach lo al hashshappud velo al haaskala. amar rabbi tzadok: maase berabban gamliel sheamar letavi avdo: tze utzele lanu et happesach al haaskala.

Gemara venayte shel mattechet? ayyeyde decham miktzato cham kullo, vekamitteve mechamat hashshappud, verachamana amar "tzeli esh", velo tzali mechamat davar acher. venayte shel dekel? ayyeyde deit leh shibbe, mappek mayya vehave kimvushshal. venayte shel teena? ayyeydi dimchalchel, mappek mayya vehave leh kimvushshal.
Venayte shel allon, shel charuv, veshel shikma? ayyeyde deit beh kitre, mappek mayya.
Shel rimmon name it beh kitre? shii kitre. veibbaet ema: benavga bar shatta, delet beh kitre. veha ikka be fiskeh! demappek leve fiskeh levar.

Matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: keshem sheshshappud shel etz eno nisraf, kach shappud shel mattechet eno martiach. amru lo: ze cham miktzato — cham kullo, veze cham miktzato — eno cham kullo.
Venoten et keraav vechulei. tanya: rabbi yishmael korehu "toch toch". rabbi tarfon korehu "gedi mekullas".
Tanu rabbanan: ezehu gedi mekullas deasur leechol belele fesach bazzeman hazze — kol shetztzelao kullo keechad! nechtach mimmennu ever, nishlak mimmennu ever — en ze gedi mekullas.
Hasheta yesh lomar nechtach mimmennu ever, deaf al gav deka mitteve leh bahadeh, amrat la — nishlak mibbaya?! amar rav sheshet: sheshshelako bimchubbar.
Amar rabba: hay mulayyta — sharya. amar leh abbaye: veha ka bala dema! amar leh: kevolah kach poltah.
Nema mesayyay leh: noten et keraav veet bene meav letocho. may tama — lav mishshum deamrinan kevolo kach polto? amri: shane hatam, kevan deikka bet hashshechita dimchalchel,
b: Medav dayyvi.
Nema mesayyay leh: hallev, koro umotzi et damo. lo kerao — koro leachar bishshulo, umuttar. may tama — lav mishshum deamrinan kevolo kach polto?
Shane lev, deshia.
(Ini) veha ravin sava tafleh hahi bar gozala lerav, vaamar leh: i mealle tifleh, hav li veechol! hahi bismida demipperir.

Veha rava ikkela leve resh galuta utefalu leh bar avoza, amar: i la dachaziteh dezig kezuza chivvara, la achali minneh. vei salka datach "kevolo kach polto" — may irya ki zig? afillu ki la zig, name! hatam bechivvarta desharir.
Vehilcheta: dismida, ben asmek ben la asmek — sharya. dechivvarta, i zig kezuza chivvara — sharya, i la — asir. dishar kemachim, asmek — asur, la asmek — shere.
Hay mulayyta, man deasar — afillu pumma letachat, uman deshare — afillu pumma leel. vehilcheta: mulayyta shere, afillu pumma leel.

Umetza, bee, umizreke, peligi ba rav acha veravina. bechol hattora kullah rav acha lechumera veravina lekulla, vehilcheta keravina lekulla. levar mehane telat derav acha lekulla veravina lechumera, vehilcheta kerav acha lekulla.

Hay umetza deasmek, chatcheh umalcheh — afillu likdera shere. shappedeh beshappuda — shere, medav dayev. achateh aggumere — peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad asar vechad share. man deasar, mitzmayt tzamet. uman deshare, mishav shaev. vehilcheta: mishav shaev.

Vechen bee, chatchinhu umalchinhu — afillu likdera sharyayn. telinhu beshappuda — sharyayn, medav dayev. achtinhu aggumere — peligi beh rav acha veravina, chad asar vechad share. man deasar, mitzmayt tzamet. uman deshare, mishav shaev.

Vechen mizreke chatcheh umalcheh — afillu likdera shere. talyeh beshappuda, bet hashshechita letattay — shere, medav daev. achateh aggumere — peligi rav acha veravina, chad asar vechad share. man deasar, mitzmayt tzamet. uman deshare, mishav shaev. vehilcheta: mishav shaev.

Hay umetza deasmek chalyeh — asir. la asmek chalyeh — shere. ravina amar: afillu la asmek name chalyeh — asir, i efshar delet be shureyayke dema. amar leh mar bar ammemar lerav ashe: abba megamma leh gammoe. ikka deamri: rav ashe gufeh megamma leh gammoe.
Amar leh mar bar ammemar lerav ashe: abba, hay challa dechalet beh chada zimna, tu la tane chalet beh. may shena mechalla matmeha dechaltinan beh? hatam — iteh

a: Lekiyyuha defera beeneh. hacha — leta lekiyyuha defera beeneh.
