En tzolin et happesach vechulei. maase listor?! chassore michassera, vehachi katane: veim askala menukkevet — muttar. veamar rabbi tzadok, maase berabban gamliel sheamar letavi avdo: tze utzele lanu et happesach al haaskala menukkevet.
Bea minneh rav chinnana bar idi merav adda bar ahava: tannur shehissiko biklippe orla ugerafo veafa bo et happat, ledivre haoser, mahu? amar leh: happat mutteret.
Amar leh: vehaamar rav chinnana sava amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: tannur shehissiko ugerafo vetzala bo et happesach — en ze tzeli esh, shenneemar "tzeli esh ... tzeli esh", shete feamim.
Tama degalli rachamana "tzeli esh" "tzeli esh" shete feamim. ha la galli rachamana, have amena tzeli esh hu.
Amar leh: galli rachamana hatam, veyalfinan minna.

Vei baet ema: hatam tama dichtav rachamana "tzeli esh" shete feamim, ha la ketav rachamana "tzeli esh" shete feamim, hava amena: aesh kafed rachamana, vaafillu gerafo name — tzeli esh hu. aval hacha, aetzim deissura ka kafed rachamana, veha letanhu.
Tanu rabbanan: chatacho, unetano al gabbe gechalim. rabbi omer: omer ani shezze tzeli esh. rame leh rav achadvuy bar amme lerav chisda: mi amar rabbi gechalim esh ninhu?

Ureminhu "michvat esh", en li ella shennichva beesh, nichva begachelet, beremetz, besid roteach, begifsis roteach, vechol davar habba min haur, leetoye chamme haur, minnayin? talmud lomar: "michva" "michva" ribba.
Tama derabbi rachamana "michva" "michva", ha la rabbi rachamana "michva" "michva", gechalim lav esh ninhu!
Amar leh: gachelet shel etz la itzterich kera lerabboye. ki itzterich kera legachelet shel mattechet.
Vegechalim shel mattechet lav esh hu? veha gabbe bat kohen, dichtiv: "baesh tissaref". veamar rav matna: petila shel avar hayu osin lah!
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "baesh tissaref", "tissaref" — lerabbot kol serefot habbaot min haesh.
Vechol shekken esh atzmah. venakkef la chavile zemorot venikla! atya "serefa" "serefa" mibbene aharon. ma lehallan — serefat neshama veguf kayyaym, af kan — serefat neshama veguf kayyaym.
Venabed la chamme haur? mishshum derav nachman, deamar rav nachman: amar kera: "veahavta lereacha kamocha", beror lo mita yafa.

Vechi meachar deikka rav nachman, gezera shava lema li? amri: i lav gezera shava, hava amena: serefat neshama veguf kayyaym — lav serefa hi. vei mishshum derav nachman — naypevsh la chavile zemorot tuva, ki hechi ditmut baagala, ka mashma lan.
Veella "baesh" lema li? leappoke avar meikkaro.

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: vechol hecha dichtiv "baesh tissaref", lerabbot kol serefot habbaot mechamat esh hu? veha gabbe parim hannisrafim, dichtiv behu: "vesaraf oto al etzim baesh", vetanya: "baesh" velo besid roteach, velo begifsis roteach?

Amar leh: hachi hasheta?! hatam ketiv "baesh" vahadar "tissaref" — lerabbot kol serefot habbaot mechamat haesh. hacha ketiv "vesaraf oto al etzim baesh" levassof "esh", lememra deesh — in, midde acharina — la.
Hatam name ketiva serefa levassof, dichtiv:
b: "Al shefech haddeshen yissaref"! amri: hahu "yissaref" mibbee leh lechidtanya: "yissaref" — af al pi sheen sham deshen. "yissaref" — af al pi shehitztzit haur berubbo.

Ravina amar, keroch uteni: "michvat esh" — en li ella shennichva beesh uvegachelet. nichva beremetz, besid roteach, uvegifsis roteach, uvechol davar habba mechamat haur, leetoye chamme haur, minnayin? talmud lomar: "michva" "michva" ribba.

Rava rame. mi amar rabbi gechalim ikkeru esh? ureminhi: "gachale" — yachol ommot, talmud lomar: "esh". i esh — yachol shalhevet, talmud lomar: "gachale". ha ketzad? mevi min hallochashot. (alma gechalim la ikkeri esh!
Amri:) veha gufa kashya, amrat: "gachale" — yachol ommot, alma lochashot esh ninhu, ema sefa: i esh — yachol shalhevet, talmud lomar: "gachale", alma afillu lochashot lav esh ninhu.

Veamar rav sheshet, hachi katane: "gachale" — yachol ben ommot ben lochashot, talmud lomar: "esh". i esh — yachol shalhevet, talmud lomar: "gachale", ha ketzad? mevi min hallochashot. mikkol makom gechalim la ikkeri esh, kashya lerabbi!

Amar abbaye, taretz hachi: "gachale" — yachol ommot velo lochashot, talmud lomar: "esh". i esh, yachol ratza shalhevet — yavi, ratza gachelet — yavi, talmud lomar: "gachale". ha ketzad? mevi min hallochashot.

Amar rabba: ratza gachelet — yavi, ratza shalhevet — yavi. shalhevet belo gachelet hechi mashkachat la? kegon deshafyeh lemana mishcha veatli beh nura. hahu lema li kera lemaote, hasheta lifne melech basar vedam en osin ken, lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu lo kol shekken!

Ella amar rava, taretz hachi: "gachale" — yachol ommot velo lochashot, talmud lomar: "esh". i esh — yachol yavi mechetza gachelet umechetza shalhevet, addeayel legavvay have kulleh gachelet — talmud lomar: "velakach melo hammachta gachale esh meal hammizbeach", mishsheat lekicha nihve gechalim.
Ibbaya lehu: ommot o ommot? amar rabbi yitzchak: "arazim lo amamuhu began elohim".
Mishna naga becharso shel tannur — yiklof et mekomo. nataf merotbo al hacheres vechazar elav — yittol et mekomo. nataf merotbo al hassolet — yikmotz et mekomo.

Sacho beshemen teruma, im chavurat kohanim — yochelu. im shel yisrael, im chay hu — yedichennu. veim tzali hu — yiklof et hachitzon. sacho beshemen shel maaser sheni — lo yaasennu damim al bene chavura, sheen podin maaser sheni birushalayim.
Gemara ittemar: cham letoch cham — divre hakkol

a: Asur. tzonen letoch tzonen — divre hakkol muttar. cham letoch tzonen, vetzonen letoch cham, rav amar: illaa gavar. ushemuel amar: tattaa gavar.

Tenan: nataf merotbo al hacheres vechazar elav — yittol et mekomo. ka salka datach becheres tzonenet. bishlama lerav deamar "illaa gavar", mishshum hachi yittol et mekomo — deazel rotev martach leh lecheres, vehadar cheres martach leh lerotev. vechi hadar rotev appesach — ka mitteve pesach mechamat chammimuta decheres, verachamana amar "tzeli esh", velo tzali mechamat davar acher.
Ella lishmuel deamar "tattaa gavar", cheres kevan detzonen hu — akkore mekar leh lerotev, ammay yittol et mekomo? kidamar rabbi yirmeya amar shemuel: besolet rotachat, hacha name becheres roteach.

Tenan: nataf merotbo al hassolet yikmotz et mekomo. ka salka datach besolet tzonenet. bishlama lerav deamar "illaa gavar", mishshum hachi yikmotz et mekomo — demartach la lesolet dehadar huderaneh, vehadra solet umartecha leh ledideh, veka mitteve rotev mechamat chammimuta desolet, verachamana amar "tzeli esh", velo tzali mechamat davar acher.
Ella lishmuel deamar "tattaa gavar", solet kevan detzonenet hi — akkore ka mekar leh, lema li yikmotz et mekomo? (tisge leh beyittol et mekomo!) amar rabbi yirmeya amar shemuel: besolet rotachat.

Tenan: sacho beshemen shel teruma, im chavurat kohanim — yochelu. im shel yisrael, im chay hu — yedichennu, im tzali hu — yiklof et hachitzon. bishlama lerav deamar "illaa gavar", ammetu lehachi saggi leh biklifa, mishshum deillaa tzonen hu.
Ella lishmuel deamar "tattaa gavar", kevan decham hu — mivla bala, ammay saggi leh biklifa? nittesar ligmare! shane sicha, demashshehu bealma hu daavida.
Tanya kevoteh dishmuel: cham letoch cham — asur. vechen tzonen shennatan letoch cham — asur. cham letoch tzonen vetzonen letoch tzonen — mediach.
Cham letoch tzonen mediach — kevan decham hu, addemekar leh — i efshar dela bala pureta, kelifa miha nive! ella ema: cham letoch tzonen — kolef, tzonen letoch tzonen — mediach.

Tanya iddach: basar roteach shennafal letoch chalav roteach, vechen tzonen shennafal letoch cham — asur. cham letoch tzonen vetzonen letoch tzonen — mediach. cham letoch tzonen mediach — kevan decham hu, addemekar leh — i efshar dela bala pureta, kelifa miha nive! ella ema: cham letoch tzonen — kolef, tzonen letoch tzonen — mediach.
Amar mar: tzonen letoch tzonen — mediach. amar rav huna: lo shanu ella shello melacho, aval melacho — asur. deamar shemuel: maliach hare hu keroteach. kavush hare hu kimvushshal.
Amar rava: ha deamar shemuel maliach hare hu keroteach (vechulei) — lo (amaran) [shanu] ella shello neechol mechamat milcho, aval neechol mechamat milcho — lo.
Hahu bar gozala dinfal lechadda dechamka, sharye rav chinnana bereh derava mippashruneya.

Amar rava: man chakkim lemishre milleta ki ha, i lav rav chinnana bereh derava mippashruneya, degavra rabba hu. amar lecha, ki amar shemuel maliach hare hu keroteach — sheen neechol mechamat milcho, hay neechol mechamat milcho.
Vehane mille chay, aval tzali — bae kelifa. vela amaran ella delet beh pile, aval it beh pile — asur. vei metubbal betavle — asur.
Amar rav:
b: Besar shechuta shamen, shetztzelao im besar nevela kachush — asur. may tama — mippattemi mehadade.
Velevi amar: afillu besar shechuta kachush, shetztzelao im besar nevela shamen — muttar. may tama — recha bealma hu, verecha lav milleta hi. aved levi ovada be resh galuta bigdi vedavar acher.
Metivi: en tzolin shene fesachim keechad mippene hattaarovet. may lav — taarovet teamim, vekashya lelevi! la, mippene taarovet gufin.

Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane sefa: afillu gedi vetale. i amrat bishlama mippene gufin — hayeynu dekatane afillu gedi vetale. ella i amrat mippene taarovet teamim, ma li gedi vetale ma li gedi ugedi.
Ella may, al korchaych mippene taarovet gufin hu deasur, aval taarovet teamim — shere, lema tehve teyuveteh derav! amar rabbi yirmeya: hacha bemay askinan, kegon shetztzelao bishte kederot.

Bishte kederot salka datach?! ella ema: keen shete kederot. vehachi kaamar: en tzolin shene fesachim keechad mippene taarovet. may taarovet — taarovet teamim. vaafillu keen shete kederot, delekka taarovet teamim — asur mishshum taarovet gufin, vaafillu gedi vetale.

Amar rav mari ketannae. harode pat chamma unetanah al pi chavit yayin shel teruma — rabbi meir oser, verabbi yehuda mattir. verabbi yose mattir beshel chittin veoser beshel seorim, mippene shehasseorim shoavot. may lav tannae hi, demar savar: recha — lav milleta hi, umar savar: recha — milleta hi.
Lelevi, vadday tannae hi. lerav, nema tannae hi?

Amar lecha rav: dechulle alma recha milleta hi, lav ittemar ala dehahi, amar rabba bar bar chana amar resh lakish: befat chamma vechavit petucha — divre hakkol asur. befat tzonenet vechavit megufa — divre hakkol muttar. lo nechleku ella befat chamma vechavit chatuma, pat tzonenet vechavit petucha. veha name kefat chamma vechavit petucha damya.

Tane rav kahana bereh derav chinnana sava: pat sheafaah im tzali battannur — asur leochlah bechuttacha. hahi binita deittevo bahade bisra, asra rava mipparzikya lemechlay bechuttacha. mar bar rav ashe amar: afillu bemilcha name asura, mishshum dekashya lerecha uledavar acher.

Mishna chamishsha devarim bain betumea, veenan neechalin betumea: haomer, ushete hallechem, velechem happanim, vezivche shalme tzibbur, useire rashe chodashim. happesach shebba betumea neechol betumea, shello ba mittechillato ella laachila.
Gemara chamishsha. lemaote may? lemaote chagigat chamishsha asar.
Desalka datach amena: kevan dekorban tzibbur hu, ukevia leh moed — tidche tumea, ka mashma lan: kevan deit leh tashlumin kol shiva — la dachaya shabbat, umiddeshabbat la dachaya — la dachaya tumea.
Venitne name seire hargalim! ha tena leh zivche shalme tzibbur. i hachi, seire rashe chodashim name la nitne, deha tena zivche shalme tzibbur! amri:

a: Seire rashe chodashim itztericha leh, salka datach amena ha la ketiv behu "moed", ka mashma lan derosh chodesh ikkeri moed,
Kidabbaye, deamar abbaye: tammuz dehay shatta malloye malleyu, dichtiv: "kara alay moed lishbor bachuray".

Lememra dechullehu mimmoed" atu, menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "vaydabber moshe et moade Adonai" — ma talmud lomar? lefi shello lamadnu ella letamid ufesach shenneemar behu "bemoado", "bemoado" vaafillu beshabbat, "bemoado" vaafillu betumea.
Shear korbenot tzibbur minnayin — shenneemar: "elle taasu laAdonai bemoadechem".
Minnayin lerabbot omer vehakkarev immo, shete hallechem vehakkarev immam — talmud lomar: "vaydabber moshe et moade Adonai el bene yisrael", hakkatuv kevao moed echad lechullan.
Vechol hane lema li? tzerichi, dei ketav rachamana tamid, hava amena tamid — shekken tadir vechalil, aval pesach — la, ka mashma lan.
Vei ketav rachamana pesach, pesach shehu anush karet, aval tamid deen anush karet — ema la, ka mashma lan.

Vei ketav rachamana hane tarte, hava amena hane hu yesh bahen tzad chamur, tamid — tadir vechalil, pesach — shehu anush karet. aval shear korbenot tzibbur — ema la, ketav rachamana: "elle taasu laAdonai bemoadechem".

Vei ketav rachamana: "elle taasu laAdonai bemoadechem", hava amena shear korbenot tzibbur habbain lechapper. aval omer ushete hallechem deen bain lechapper, ella lehattir bealma ninhu — la, ka mashma lan.
Vei ketav rachamana omer ushete hallechem lechodayyhu, hava amena adderabba: omer ushete hallechem deallimi devain lehattir, aval hanach — la, ka mashma lan.
Savruha dilchulle alma tumea dechuya hi betzibbur, uvaaya tzitz leratztzot.

Delekka tanna deshamat leh deamar tumea huttera betzibbur ella rabbi yehuda, detanya: tzitz, ben sheyyeshno al mitzcho uven sheeno al mitzcho — meratztze, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda omer: odehu al mitzcho — meratztze, en odehu al mitzcho — eno meratztze.
Amar lo rabbi shimon: kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim yochiach, sheeno al mitzcho umeratztze.
Amar lo: hannach leyom hakkippurim shettumea huttera betzibbur. mikkelal derabbi shimon savar: tumea dechuya hi betzibbur.

Udechulle alma en hatztzitz meratztze al achilot, delekka tanna deshamat leh deamar hatztzitz meratztze al achilot ella rabbi eliezer, detanya: rabbi eliezer omer: hatztzitz meratztze al achilot, rabbi yose omer: en hatztzitz meratztze al achilot.
Nema matnitin dela kerabbi yehoshua, detanya: "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam", rabbi yehoshua omer: im en dam — en basar, im en basar — en dam.
Rabbi eliezer omer: dam — af al pi sheen basar, shenneemar: "vedam zevachecha yishshafech", uma ani mekayyem "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam" — lomar lecha: ma dam bizrika, af basar bizrika.
Heve omer: lul katan yesh ben kevesh lammizbeach.
Verabbi yehoshua name, hachtiv "vedam zevachecha yishshafech"! amar lach: ha ketiv gabbeh "vehabbasar tochel".
b: Vehane tere kerae lema li? chad beola, vechad bishlamim. utzericha, dei ketav rachamana beola, hava amena: ola hi dachamira, shekken kalil, aval shelamim dela chamiri, ema la.
Vei ketav rachamana shelamim, hava amena: adderabba, deit behu shete achilot. aval ola delet bah shete achilot, ema la, ka mashma lan.
Verabbi eliezer name, hachtiv "vehabbasar tochel"! amar lach: hahu mibbee leh ashsheen habbasar muttar baachila ad sheyyizzarek haddam.
I hachi, ema kulleh lehachi hu daata! dam af al pi sheen sham basar menalan?

Amar lach: im ken, nichtov rachamana "habbasar tochel" vahadar "vedam zevachecha yishshafech", kedichtiv beresha "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam", may shena deakdemeh ledam zevachecha"? shema minna: dam af al pi sheen basar, ushema minna: sheen habbasar muttar baachila ad sheyyizzarek haddam.

Verabbi yehoshua, en habbasar muttar baachila ad sheyyizzarek haddam — kal vachomer hu, uma emurin dechi letanhu — la meakkevi, ki itanhu — meakkevi, dam, dechi leteh — meakkev, ki iteh — lo kol shekken dimakkev!
Verabbi eliezer? milleta deatya bekal vachomer tarach vechatev la kera. verabbi yehoshua? kol hecha deikka lemidrash — darshinan.
Hasheta lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehoshua, dechevan deamar baenan tarte, vetzitz aachilot lo meratztze, hechi ate betumea?
Afillu tema rabbi yehoshua, ella kasavar rabbi yehoshua: hatztzitz meratztze al haolin.
Ha tinach zevachim deikka olin, ella omer ushete hallechem delekka olin, may ikka lememar? amri: ki amar rabbi yehoshua name devaenan tarte — bizvachim, bimnachot la amar.
Uvimnachot la amar? vehatnan: nitmeu sheyareha, avdu sheyareha, kemiddat rabbi eliezer — keshera, kemiddat rabbi yehoshua — pesula.
Kemiddat velo kemiddat: kemiddat rabbi yehoshua, devaenan tarte. velo kemiddat rabbi yehoshua, deillu rabbi yehoshua bizvachim amar, bimnachot — la amar, veillu hay tanna savar: afillu bimnachot.
Umannu hay tanna dekae kevoteh umachmer tefe minneh? veod, tanya amar rabbi yose: roe ani et divre rabbi eliezer bimnachot uvizvachim, vedivre rabbi yehoshua bizvachim uvimnachot.

Divre rabbi eliezer bizvachim, shehaya omer: dam — af al pi sheen sham basar. vedivre rabbi yehoshua bizvachim, shehaya omer: im en dam — en basar, im en basar — en dam. divre rabbi eliezer bimnachot, shehaya omer: kometz — af al pi sheen shirayim, divre rabbi yehoshua bimnachot, shehaya omer: im en kometz — en shirayim, im en shirayim — en kometz.
Ella, kasavar rabbi yehoshua: hatztzitz meratztze al [haolin veal] haachilot.
I hachi, ammay kemiddat rabbi yehoshua pesula? aavud vesaruf.
Ella nitma, leman katane? lerabbi eliezer — peshita, hasheta yesh lomar avud vesaruf deletanhu, machshir rabbi eliezer, nitma deiteh — mibbaya? ella peshita lerabbi yehoshua, vekatane pesula.

Veod, tanya rabbi yehoshua omer: kol zevachim shebbattora, ben shennitma basar vechelev kayyaym, uven shennitma chelev uvasar kayyaym — zorek et haddam. aval nitmeu tarvavyyhu — la. alma kasavar rabbi yehoshua en hatztzitz meratztze al haolin velo al haachilot!
Ella: leolam rabbi yehoshua hi matnitin, vela kashya: kan — lechattechilla, kan — diavad. ki amar rabbi yehoshua — lechattechilla, diavad la.

Umena temra deshane leh lerabbi yehoshua ben lechattechilla lediavad — detanya: nitma basar o shennifsal o sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim, rabbi eliezer omer: yizzarek, rabbi yehoshua omer: lo yizzarek. umode rabbi yehoshua sheim zarak — huretza.
Chada, difsula" — diavad mashma. veod, "chamishsha devarim bain" — lechattechilla mashma.

a: Ella, la kashya: kan — beyachid, kan — betzibbur.
Nema matnitin dela kerabbi yose. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: hatztzitz meratztze al achilot. rabbi yose omer: en hatztzitz meratztze al achilot.
Ka salka datach middekaamar rabbi yose: en hatztzitz meratztze al achilot — kerabbi yehoshua sevira leh, deamar baenan tarte. nema hasheta matnitin dela kerabbi yose?
La, rabbi yose kerabbi eliezer sevira leh, deamar: dam — af al pi sheen basar.

I hachi, lemay hilcheta en hatztzitz meratztze al achilot? velitamaych, rabbi eliezer deamar: hatztzitz meratztze, kevan deamar: dam — af al pi sheen basar, hatztzitz meratztze al achilot lemay hilcheta?
Ella, lemikbeeh befiggul uleappoke mide meila kamippalgi. rabbi eliezer savar: meratztze tzitz illaveh umeshavve leh ketahor, vekava leh befiggul, umappek leh midde meila.
Verabbi yose savar: la meratztze tzitz illaveh, vela meshavve leh ketahor, vela kava leh befiggul, vela mappek leh midde meila.
Matkef la rav mari: nehi name derabbi yose savar kerabbi eliezer, bishlama zevachim — ikka dam, omer name — ikka kometz, lechem happanim name — ikka bazichin.
Ella shete hallechem, may ikka lememar?
Vechi tema likrav immahen — hayeynu shalme tzibbur. im ken, havu lehu arbaa, vaanan — chamishsha tenan!
Ella, kasavar rabbi yose: tumea huttera betzibbur.
Veha tanya: echad ze veechad ze — mazzin alav kol shiva mikkol chattaot shehayu sham, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: en mazzin alav ella shelishi ushevii bilvad.
Vei salka datach kasavar rabbi yose tumea huttera betzibbur, lema li hazzaa kelal? ella mechavvavrta matnitin dela kerabbi yose.

Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: verabbi yose shetara mezakke leve tere hu?! detanya, amar rabbi yose: roe ani et divre rabbi eliezer bizvachim, vedivre rabbi yehoshua bizvachim, vedivre rabbi eliezer bimnachot, vedivre rabbi yehoshua bimnachot.

Divre rabbi eliezer bizvachim, shehaya omer: dam af al pi sheen basar. divre rabbi yehoshua bizvachim, shehaya omer: im en dam en basar, im en basar en dam. divre rabbi eliezer bimnachot, shehaya omer: kometz — af al pi sheen sham shirayim. vedivre rabbi yehoshua bimnachot, shehaya omer: im en sham shirayim en kometz, im en kometz en shirayim!
Amar leh: mistabbera kaamar. ki kae bizvachim, amar: mistabbera ki hechi difligi bizvachim — peligi name bimnachot. kae bimnachot, amar: mistabbera ki hechi difligi bimnachot — peligi name bizvachim.

Amar leh, hatinach: ki kae bizvachim amar, mistabbera ki hechi difligi bizvachim peligi name bimnachot, deikkar kerae ki ketivi — bizvachim ketivi. ella, ki kae bimnachot veamar, mistabbera ki hechi difligi bimnachot peligi name bizvachim — veha ikkar kerae bizvachim hu dichtivi!
Ella, la kashya: roe ani et divre rabbi eliezer benitma, vedivre rabbi yehoshua beavud vesaruf.
Benitma may tama — mishshum dimratztze tzitz. ha shamat leh lerabbi yose deamar: en hatztzitz meratztze al achilot!
Ella, la kashya: roe ani et divre rabbi eliezer betzibbur, roe ani et divre rabbi yehoshua beyachid.
Betzibbur may tama — mishshum detumea huttera betzibbur? chada: deshamat leh lerabbi yose deamar tumea dechuya hi betzibbur, veod: i betzibbur, rabbi eliezer machshir vela rabbi yehoshua?
b: Ha amrat, betzibbur afillu rabbi yehoshua mode.
Ella: roe ani divre rabbi eliezer bediavad, vedivre rabbi yehoshua lechattechilla. diavad — afillu rabbi yehoshua name mode hu, dekatane: mode rabbi yehoshua sheim zarak — huretza!
Ha betumea, ha beavud vesaruf. ki katane: mode rabbi yehoshua sheim zarak huretza — benitma, aval beavud vesaruf la. ki kaamar rabbi yose: roe ani et divre rabbi eliezer bediavad — beavud vesaruf.

Mishna nitma basar vechelev kayyaym — eno zorek et haddam. nitma hachelev vehabbasar kayyaym — zorek et haddam. uvammukedashim eno ken, ella af al pi shennitma habbasar vehachelev kayyaym — zorek et haddam.
Gemara amar rav giddel amar rav: im zarak — huretza. veha baenan achila! achila la meakkeva.
Veha ketiv: "ish lefi ochlo"?! lemitzva.

Uleakkev la? vehatanya: "bemichsat", melammed sheen happesach nishchat ella limnuyav. yachol shechato shello limnuyav yehe keover al hammitzva vechasher — talmud lomar: "ish lefi ochlo tachossu", hakkatuv shana alav leakkev.
Veittakkash ochlin limnuyin.
Ella rav deamar kerabbi natan, deamar: achilat pesachim la meakkeva.

He rabbi natan? illema ha rabbi natan detanya, rabbi natan omer: minnayin shekkol yisrael yotzin befesach echad — talmud lomar: "veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael ben haarbayim", vechi kol hakkahal shochatin? vahalo en shochet ella echad! ella melammed shekkol yisrael yotzin befesach echad.
Dilma shane hatam, dei mimmashchi hane chaze lehane, vei mimmashchi hane chaze lehane!

Ella, ha rabbi natan detanya: nimnu alav chavura achat, vechazru venimnu alav chavura acheret, rishonim sheyyesh lahen kezayit, ochlin — ufeturin millaasot pesach sheni, acharonim sheen lahem kazzayit, en ochlin — vechayyayvin laasot pesach sheni.
Rabbi natan omer: ellu veellu peturin millaasot pesach sheni, shekkevar nizrak haddam.
Akkatti: dilma shane hatam, dei mimmashchi hane chaze lehu. im ken, litne: hoil ureuyim limmashech, may "shekkevar nizrak haddam"? shema minna bedam talya milleta, aval achila la meakkeva.

May duchekeh derav demokem la matnitin lechattechilla, verabbi natan? nokma kerabbanan, vaafillu diavad name la! rav matnitin keshiteh: ammay (tane) "en zorek et haddam"? litne "pasul". ella shema minna: "en zorek" — lechattechilla, aval diavad shappir dame.
Ulerabbi natan, "ish lefi ochlo" lema li? devaenan gavra dachaze laachila.
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: shachatu leochlav vezarku damo shello leochlav — happesach atzmo kasher, veadam yotze bo yede chovato. keman? nema rabbi natan hi, vela rabbanan?
Afillu tema rabbanan, en machshevet ochlin bizrika.

Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: hare shehaya chole bishat shechita vechalim bishat zerika, chalim bishat shechita vechole bishat zerika. en shochatin vezorkin alav, ad sheyyehe chalim mishsheat shechita ad sheat zerika. keman? nema rabbanan hi, vela rabbi natan? afillu tema rabbi natan, gavra dachaze laachila baenan.
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: shechato betohora, veachar kach nitmeu habbealim — yizzarek haddam betohora, veal yeachel basar betumea. keman?
Amar rabbi (eliezer): bemachloket shenuya, verabbi natan hi. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbanan hi. hacha bemay askinan — betzibbur, daafillu betumea name avdi.

I betzibbur, ammay en habbasar neechol betumea? gezera shemma yittamu habbealim leachar zerika, veyomru: eshtakad lo nitmenu veachalnu? hasheta name nechol. vela yadi deeshtakad ki izderik dam, bealim temeim havo, hasheta bealim tehorin havu.
